instructions.en: If you are giving the baby solid foods, make sure you feed him in the same place for each meal. This will help him begin to understand the routine of eating. Before you give him a spoonful of food, show it to him and tell him what he is eating. He will start to anticipate mealtime and begin to demonstrate some excitement.
instructions.zh: 如果宝宝已经开始吃辅食，每次都在同一个地方喂饭，帮助宝宝认识吃饭的固定流程。每喂一勺之前，先让宝宝看看食物，并告诉宝宝正在吃什么。宝宝会逐渐期待用餐，并表现出兴奋。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Begins to develop strong preferences for different food tastes.
milestone.zh: 开始对不同食物的味道形成明显偏好。

goal.en: Improve the baby's ability to handle different types of objects appropriately
goal.zh: 提高宝宝根据物品特点采用适当操作方式的能力

instructions.en: Teach him to use different types of touch for various objects around him. For example, to touch a flower gently, or massage play dough, bang a drum, or softly touch Mom's face.
instructions.zh: 教宝宝用不同的触摸方式接触身边的物品。例如，轻轻摸花朵、揉捏橡皮泥、敲鼓，或轻柔地摸妈妈的脸。

materials.en: Objects around you (i.e., flowers, your face, play dough, etc.)
materials.zh: 身边的物品，例如花朵、照护者的脸、橡皮泥等

goal.en: Expand the baby's capacity to follow moving objects
goal.zh: 提高宝宝追踪移动物体的能力

instructions.en: Give the baby a balloon to play with, encouraging him to follow its slow movement with his eyes and his body.
instructions.zh: 给宝宝一个气球玩，鼓励宝宝用眼睛和身体追随气球缓慢的移动。

materials.zh: 气球，尽可能使用铝膜气球

reminder.en: Balloons are choking hazards. Do not let the baby play with them alone or put them in the mouth; remove broken balloons and fragments.
reminder.zh: 气球有窒息风险，不要交给宝宝独自拿着或放入口中；破损气球和碎片应立即移开。

reminderBasis: AAP：Choking Prevention

goal.zh: 通过游戏进行社交互动

instructions.en: Play games with the baby that encourage the use of his hands, like clapping, rubbing his hands together, patting surfaces, and other similar activities.
instructions.zh: 和宝宝玩需要动手的游戏，例如拍手、双手互相搓动、拍打物体表面，以及其他类似的活动。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

instructions.en: With the baby lying on his back, bend his legs completely until you feel a small resistance. Then fully extend them and repeat the exercise.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝仰卧，将双腿充分弯曲，直到感觉到轻微阻力。然后充分伸直双腿，再重复这个动作。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

goal.en: Introduce the concept of body parts

instructions.en: Show the baby different parts of her body and tell her: "This is your hand," "This is your foot," and so on. This is especially good when she is naked, during diaper changes, or in the bathtub. Take the opportunity to name body parts whenever you can.
instructions.zh: 给宝宝指出身体的不同部位，并说：“这是你的手”“这是你的脚”等。宝宝没有穿衣服、换尿布或洗澡时，特别适合做这项活动。尽可能利用机会说出身体部位的名称。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Explores body with mouth and hands.
milestone.zh: 用嘴和双手探索身体。

goal.en: Increase the baby's understanding of itself as a separate entity
goal.zh: 增强宝宝对自己是独立个体的理解

instructions.en: Sitting or standing in front of a mirror with your baby, name each part of the body while pointing to it. Focus on five parts at a time, with the primary parts first. You can also use the opportunity to sing a song that includes parts of the body like "Head, Shoulders, Knees and Toes."
instructions.zh: 抱着宝宝在镜子前坐着或站着，一边指向身体部位，一边说出名称。每次重点介绍五个部位，先从主要部位开始。也可以唱带有身体部位名称的歌，例如《头、肩膀、膝盖和脚趾》。

materials.zh: 镜子

milestone.en: Explores body with mouth and hands.
milestone.zh: 用嘴和双手探索身体。

instructions.en: Try to get the baby's attention focused on a large object. Move him around the object, above and below, so that he can see it from different perspectives.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝注意一个较大的物体。带着宝宝在物体周围移动，从上方和下方观察，让宝宝从不同角度看同一物体。

materials.zh: 较大的物体

milestone.en: Looks at objects from different perspectives, turning them in various positions to see them in their entirety.
milestone.zh: 从不同角度观察物品，并转动物品以看清整体。

goal.en: Encourage the baby to make sounds

instructions.en: Use any activity that you are doing with your baby like eating dinner, bathing him, receiving a friend's visit as an excuse to start a dialogue about it with him.
instructions.zh: 把和宝宝一起做的任何活动作为聊天的机会，例如吃晚饭、洗澡或朋友来访，围绕正在发生的事情和宝宝展开对话。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Improved vocal play; transitioning to babbling.
milestone.zh: 发声游戏有所进步，逐渐进入咿呀学语阶段。

instructions.en: When you are in front of the baby, clap your hands. Start slowly to try to get the baby to imitate you. You can also open and close your hands, grabbing small objects while he observes you.
instructions.zh: 在宝宝面前拍手。先慢慢地拍，尝试让宝宝模仿。也可以张开、合拢双手，或在宝宝观看时抓取小物品。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Clapping: might start clapping hands (between months 6 and 9).
milestone.zh: 拍手：可能开始拍手（约6–9个月）。

instructions.en: Clap and raise your arms rhythmically, trying to get the baby to imitate you.
instructions.zh: 有节奏地拍手并抬起双臂，尝试让宝宝模仿。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Clapping: might start clapping hands (between months 6 and 9).
milestone.zh: 拍手：可能开始拍手（约6–9个月）。

instructions.en: Put a variety of objects in front of the baby and teach him to classify them by functionality. For example, put a shirt, pants and shoes together and say, "These are clothes that we wear on our body!" Group a spoon, plate, and cup together and say, "These are things we use to help us eat."
instructions.zh: 在宝宝面前放几种物品，教宝宝按用途分类。例如，把上衣、裤子和鞋放在一起，说：“这些是穿在身上的衣服！”把勺子、盘子和杯子放在一起，说：“这些是帮助我们吃饭的东西！”

materials.en: Groups of objects (i.e., items of clothing, utensils)
materials.zh: 几组物品，例如衣物、餐具

instructions.en: Throughout the day, take the opportunity to show the baby how some activities precede others. For example, while washing his hands explain how you do this before eating; that you open the door before you can go outside, that you put on a diaper before pants, and other examples.
instructions.zh: 在一天中找机会让宝宝了解，有些事情要在另一些事情之前做。例如，洗手时说明吃饭前要先洗手；出门前要先开门；穿裤子前要先穿好尿布，并举出其他例子。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Gets excited when realizes that it is playtime.
milestone.zh: 意识到要玩耍时表现出兴奋。

instructions.en: Make sure the baby is on a soft surface like a carpet, bed, or blanket. While facing down, but with his bottom raised, put one of his favorite toys 6 to 12 inches in front of him. Gently push him from the buttocks until he can reach it. Celebrate when he reaches the toy.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝在柔软表面上，例如地毯、床或毯子上，面朝下并抬起臀部。把喜欢的玩具放在前方6–12英寸（约15–30厘米）处。从臀部轻轻向前推，帮助宝宝够到玩具。够到时给予鼓励。

materials.zh: 玩具

milestone.en: Attempts to get up on hands and knees to get into a crawling position.
milestone.zh: 尝试用双手和膝盖撑起身体，进入爬行姿势。

instructions.en: With the baby facing down on hands and knees, grab her feet and help her slide each leg forward slowly, just as if she were crawling.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝面朝下，用双手和膝盖支撑。握住宝宝的双脚，慢慢帮助两条腿轮流向前滑动，像爬行一样。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Attempts to get up on hands and knees to get into a crawling position.
milestone.zh: 尝试用双手和膝盖撑起身体，进入爬行姿势。

instructions.en: Put the baby face down on a big cylinder, like a bolster, a short pool noodle, or a wide mailing tube, in a way in which both her arms and legs are touching the floor. Put your hand on the baby's back, helping her roll the cylinder back and forth. Encourage her to do the movements by herself.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝趴在大圆柱体上，例如圆柱抱枕、短泡沫泳棒或宽纸筒，使双手和双腿都接触地面。把手放在宝宝背上，帮助圆柱体来回滚动，并鼓励宝宝自己做这些动作。

materials.en: Big cylinder or a bolster (needs to roll)
materials.zh: 可滚动的大圆柱体或圆柱抱枕

milestone.en: Attempts to get up on hands and knees to get into a crawling position.
milestone.zh: 尝试用双手和膝盖撑起身体，进入爬行姿势。

goal.zh: 学习重复产生特定声音

instructions.en: Using a noisy toy, like a rattle or small box with a stone inside, shake it to produce a noise. Finish by knocking the toy against a table or drum. Encourage the baby to try it.
instructions.zh: 用会响的玩具，例如摇铃或里面放有小石头的小盒子，摇出声音。最后把玩具敲在桌子或鼓上，鼓励宝宝也试一试。

materials.en: Rattle, maraca, or small box with stone inside
materials.zh: 摇铃、沙锤，或里面放有小石头的小盒子

milestone.en: High level of interest in toys that produce sounds like bells, music boxes and rattles.
milestone.zh: 对铃铛、音乐盒、摇铃等发声玩具很感兴趣。

reminder.en: The source uses a box containing a stone. Keep it securely closed with no accessible or detachable small parts.
reminder.zh: 原文使用装石头的小盒子。请确保容器不能被打开，石头或零件不能脱落、入口。

reminderBasis: AAP：Choking Prevention

instructions.en: Using one of the baby's favorite toys, help him to grab it, drop it, and then pick it up again. Describe the activity as he does it. For example, "The ball fell, let's pick up the ball."
instructions.zh: 用宝宝喜欢的玩具，帮助宝宝抓住、放下，再捡起来。宝宝操作时，描述正在做的事，例如：“球掉下去了，我们把球捡起来。”

materials.en: Several toys with different shapes and colors
materials.zh: 几种形状和颜色不同的玩具

milestone.en: Nearly always uses a single arm to reach for something, rather than using both.
milestone.zh: 伸手够东西时，几乎总是用单臂而不是双臂。

goal.en: Improve visual tracking and visual memory
goal.zh: 改善视觉追踪和视觉记忆

instructions.en: Put colorful toys or objects in front of the baby. Pick up each one and let it drop near him. Bring his attention to the place where the object landed. If he tries to grab one of the objects, let him, making sure he can see both his hand and object simultaneously.
instructions.zh: 把色彩鲜艳的玩具或物品放在宝宝面前。逐个拿起来，让它们掉在宝宝附近，引导宝宝注意落点。如果宝宝想抓其中一个，就让宝宝抓，同时确保宝宝能看见自己的手和那个物品。

materials.zh: 色彩鲜艳的玩具

milestone.en: Extends arm out to reach for an object that has fallen.
milestone.zh: 伸出手臂去够掉落的物品。

instructions.en: If you are feeding the baby solids already, show him the food in his bowl before feeding him. Allow him to play with the spoon and a sippy cup. Whether he is eating solids or not, sit him next to you during family meals to introduce him to eating habits.
instructions.zh: 如果已经开始喂辅食，喂之前先给宝宝看看碗里的食物。让宝宝玩勺子和学饮杯。无论是否开始吃辅食，都让宝宝在家人用餐时坐在你旁边，认识吃饭的习惯。

materials.zh: 勺子、盘子、食物

milestone.en: Might be able to grab and move a cup by the handle.
milestone.zh: 可能会握住杯把并移动杯子。

instructions.en: Give the baby cylindrical or round objects and encourage him to hold them and explore them with his hands.
instructions.zh: 给宝宝圆柱形或圆形物品，鼓励宝宝拿住，并用双手探索。

materials.zh: 圆柱形或圆形物品

milestone.en: Examines objects for a long period of time.
milestone.zh: 能长时间仔细观察物品。

instructions.en: Take your baby to different places and talk about the places you are visiting, the actions that are happening, and specific situations or people that might be unfamiliar.
instructions.zh: 带宝宝去不同的地方，介绍正在参观的地方、发生的活动，以及宝宝可能不熟悉的具体情境或人物。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Actively looks around when in a new place, exploring surroundings.
milestone.zh: 到新地方时，会主动四处观察，探索环境。

goal.en: Increasing the baby's understanding and control of its surroundings
goal.zh: 增强宝宝对周围环境的理解和掌控

instructions.en: Allow the baby to touch your face and hair with his hands. As he touches different parts of your face, describe what he is touching.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝用双手摸你的脸和头发。宝宝摸到脸的不同部位时，说出正在摸什么。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

goal.en: Increasing the baby's understanding and control of its surroundings
goal.zh: 增强宝宝对周围环境的理解和掌控

instructions.en: Place several toys with different textures and shapes close to the baby, so that he can explore them and interact with them. You can use toys made of fabric, rubber, plastic, wood, or foam.
instructions.zh: 把几种材质和形状不同的玩具放在宝宝身边，让宝宝探索并操作。可以使用布、橡胶、塑料、木头或泡沫做的玩具。

materials.en: Toys made of different textures (fabric, rubber, plastic, wood, etc.)
materials.zh: 不同材质的玩具，例如布、橡胶、塑料、木头等

milestone.en: Wants to touch, grab, manipulate, shake, and taste objects.
milestone.zh: 想触摸、抓握、操作、摇动物品，并用嘴探索。

instructions.en: Take the baby on a tour around your house to touch fabrics with different textures, like curtains, bedding, towels, and clothing.
instructions.zh: 带宝宝在家中走一走，摸摸不同质感的布料，例如窗帘、床上用品、毛巾和衣服。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

goal.en: Encourage the baby to make sounds

instructions.en: Using a happy tone of voice, try to get your baby excited about specific things, like his favorite toy or another baby. "Look at your dog toy!" or "Look at the baby, how cute!" Try to get expressions of excitement from him, like squeals or smiles.
instructions.zh: 用开心的语气，让宝宝对具体事物感到兴奋，例如喜欢的玩具或另一个宝宝。可以说：“看，你的小狗玩具！”或“看那个宝宝，多可爱！”尝试引出尖叫、微笑等兴奋的表现。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Might direct sounds toward nearby people, objects and toys.
milestone.zh: 可能会朝附近的人、物品或玩具发声。

instructions.en: Open and close your eyes or mouth slowly in front of the baby and encourage her to imitate you. Initially, the baby will likely be confused and may open and close her eyes while you are doing the same with your mouth. With repetition, she will do it correctly.
instructions.zh: 在宝宝面前慢慢睁眼、闭眼，或张嘴、闭嘴，鼓励宝宝模仿。刚开始宝宝可能会混淆，例如你张嘴、闭嘴时，宝宝却睁眼、闭眼。多次重复后，宝宝会逐渐正确模仿。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Imitation: purposely tries to mimic simple sounds and movements.
milestone.zh: 模仿：有意识地尝试模仿简单声音和动作。

goal.en: Identify the source of a sound

instructions.en: While he is looking elsewhere, call him by his name. Once he turns to look at you, excitedly say: "Yes! I'm here, you found me!"
instructions.zh: 宝宝看着别处时，叫宝宝的名字。宝宝转头看你后，兴奋地说：“对！我在这里，你找到我了！”

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Begins to Recognize Own Name: reacts when called by name.
milestone.zh: 开始认识自己的名字：听到名字时有反应。

goal.en: Identify the source of a sound

instructions.en: Throughout the day, use different types of sounds to get the baby's attention and to have her try to find the source of the sound. You can call her by her name, clap loudly, turn on the radio, and play musical instruments.
instructions.zh: 在一天中用不同声音吸引宝宝注意，鼓励宝宝寻找声音从哪里来。可以叫名字、响亮地拍手、打开收音机或演奏乐器。

materials.zh: 多种声音来源

milestone.en: High level of interest in toys that produce sounds like bells, music boxes and rattles.
milestone.zh: 对铃铛、音乐盒、摇铃等发声玩具很感兴趣。

instructions.en: Make funny faces, show the baby your tongue, and breathe heavily trying to get the baby to imitate you.
instructions.zh: 做有趣的表情、向宝宝伸舌头、夸张地呼吸，尝试让宝宝模仿。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

goal.en: Develop ability to hold objects with both hands at the same time
goal.zh: 发展同时用双手拿物品的能力

instructions.en: Give the baby large toys and objects that encourage him to use both hands to hold them and play with them. Stuffed animals, balls, or a small pillow would be effective.
instructions.zh: 给宝宝较大的玩具或物品，鼓励用双手拿着并玩耍。例如毛绒玩具、球或小枕头。

materials.en: Big objects (big stuffed animal, small pillow, a ball, etc.)
materials.zh: 较大的物品，例如大毛绒玩具、小枕头、球

milestone.en: Two-Hand Hold: can hold objects with both hands.
milestone.zh: 双手抓握：能够用双手拿住物品。

instructions.en: Give the baby a large wooden or plastic ring. Encourage him to use only his middle, ring, and pinkie fingers to grab it. You will likely need to help at first, but you can gradually decrease the level of assistance you provide him until he does it by himself. Repeat the exercise with other objects like large sticks or teething cookies.
instructions.zh: 给宝宝一个较大的木环或塑料环，鼓励只用中指、无名指和小指抓住。开始时可能需要帮助，再逐渐减少帮助，直到宝宝能独立完成。也可以换用较大的棒状物或磨牙饼干重复练习。

materials.zh: 木环或塑料环

instructions.en: Give the baby objects with different shapes and textures. Try to have him grab them with just his thumb and index fingers. Start with larger objects such as large wooden sticks or teething biscuits and gradually decrease their size.
instructions.zh: 给宝宝不同形状和质感的物品，尝试让宝宝只用拇指和食指抓取。先从较大的物品开始，例如大木棒或磨牙饼干，再逐渐减小尺寸。

materials.en: Objects with different shapes and textures (blocks, large wooden sticks, pieces of foam)
materials.zh: 不同形状和质感的物品，例如积木、大木棒、泡沫块

milestone.en: Radial Palmar Grasp: objects are secured using the radial side of the palm, the thumb, the index and the middle fingers; all other fingers remain flexed.
milestone.zh: 桡侧掌抓握：用手掌靠拇指一侧及拇指、食指和中指固定物品，其他手指保持弯曲。

reminder.en: The source suggests decreasing object size. Avoid objects small enough to swallow and detachable small parts.
reminder.zh: 原文建议逐渐减小物品尺寸。不要减小到可吞咽的尺寸，也不要让宝宝接触易脱落的小零件。

reminderBasis: AAP：Choking Prevention

instructions.en: Allow her to explore and handle objects with obvious differences in weight.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝探索和操作重量明显不同的物品。

materials.en: Toys or objects with different weights
materials.zh: 重量不同的玩具或物品

instructions.en: Partially hide one of his favorite toys under a blanket. Then ask him where it is, revealing it to him after a few seconds. Gradually increase the portion of the toy that is hidden until it is completely under the blanket. You can accomplish a similar objective by playing peekaboo.
instructions.zh: 把喜欢的玩具的一部分藏在毯子下面。问宝宝玩具在哪里，过几秒再揭开。逐渐增加遮住的部分，直到整个玩具都藏在毯子下面。玩躲猫猫也能达到类似目标。

materials.zh: 玩具和遮盖物

milestone.en: Object Permanence: is conscious that an object is partially hidden, is still there, and could reach it.
milestone.zh: 物体恒存：知道部分被遮住的物品仍然存在，并能伸手去拿。

instructions.en: Fill the baby's bottle 1/4 to 1/3 full and help him place his hands around the bottle to hold it. Over time, he will grab it himself and be able to hold it with both hands.
instructions.zh: 把奶瓶装到四分之一至三分之一满，帮助宝宝把双手放在奶瓶周围并握住。逐渐地，宝宝会自己抓住奶瓶，并能用双手拿稳。

materials.zh: 奶瓶

milestone.en: Two-Hand Hold: can hold objects with both hands.
milestone.zh: 双手抓握：能够用双手拿住物品。

goal.en: Improve the baby's range of facial expressions

instructions.en: Imitate any facial expression your baby makes: smiling, crying, yawning, and any others.
instructions.zh: 模仿宝宝做出的各种表情，例如微笑、哭泣、打哈欠等。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Imitation: purposely tries to mimic simple sounds and movements.
milestone.zh: 模仿：有意识地尝试模仿简单声音和动作。

instructions.en: Repeat and reinforce sounds or noises that he makes that are similar to actual words. For example, if he makes a "Goo" sound, you can respond with "Did you say GOOD?"
instructions.zh: 重复并强化宝宝发出的、听起来接近真实词语的声音。例如，宝宝发出“Goo”（咕）的声音，你可以回应：“你说的是GOOD（好）吗？”

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Reduplicated Babbling: repetition of the same consonant-vowel syllable (e.g., "baba," "mama"); doesn't understand meaning.
milestone.zh: 重复性咿呀学语：重复同一个辅音加元音的音节（如“baba”“mama”），还不理解含义。

instructions.en: Expose your baby to different people. Get her used to interacting and playing with them as actively as possible.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝接触不同的人，逐渐习惯尽可能积极地和他们互动、玩耍。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Social Skills: engages with other people, with preference for parents; smiles more openly.
milestone.zh: 社交能力：会与他人互动，更偏爱父母，笑容更明显。

instructions.en: Hang a few toys or mobiles within reach of the baby's legs and encourage him to kick them with his legs until they move.
instructions.zh: 在宝宝双腿能够够到的地方悬挂几个玩具或悬挂转动玩具，鼓励宝宝用腿踢，让它们动起来。

materials.zh: 玩具、悬挂转动玩具、摇铃

milestone.en: Makes vigorous swimming-like movements.
milestone.zh: 会做有力的、像游泳一样的动作。

reminder.en: Do not use reachable hanging crib toys for this 7-month-old. AAP advises removing mobiles by 5 months or when pushing up on hands and knees, whichever comes first.
reminder.zh: 原文提到悬挂玩具。7个月宝宝的床内不可使用可触及的悬挂玩具；AAP建议最迟5个月或开始用手膝撑起时移除床内悬挂玩具。

reminderBasis: AAP：How to Buy Safe Toys

goal.zh: 通过游戏进行社交互动

instructions.en: Hold the baby firmly underneath her armpits. Lift her up and down and move her side to side-to-side, laughing and smiling while you do it.
instructions.zh: 从腋下稳稳抱住宝宝，向上、向下抬动，再左右移动，过程中笑着和宝宝互动。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

instructions.en: With the baby lying on his back, grab his hands and slowly pull him up to a 45-degree angle and, if he is ready, bring him to a complete seated position.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝仰卧，握住双手，慢慢向上拉到45度。如果宝宝已经准备好，可以继续到完全坐起的位置。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

reminder.en: Pause before using this instruction. It pulls the baby up by the hands; AAP advises against pulling or lifting children by their hands or wrists. Review with a pediatrician or pediatric physical therapist.
reminder.zh: 先暂停照做。原文包含拉双手坐起；AAP建议不要通过拉手或手腕提起孩子。请先让儿科医生或儿童物理治疗师确认动作。

reminderBasis: AAP：Nursemaid’s Elbow

goal.en: Improve balance and ability to remain in a sitting position
goal.zh: 改善平衡和保持坐姿的能力

instructions.en: Place the baby in a seated position in front of you on the floor, holding his arms or hips to keep him steady. When he is steady, gradually move away from him so that he is sitting on his own for short periods of time.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝在你面前的地板上坐着，扶住手臂或髋部，帮助保持稳定。坐稳后逐渐离开一点，让宝宝短时间自己坐着。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Able to stay in a sitting position for a few seconds without assistance.
milestone.zh: 不用帮助，也能保持坐姿几秒钟。

goal.en: Improve balance and ability to remain in a sitting position
goal.zh: 改善平衡和保持坐姿的能力

instructions.en: Look for activities that the baby likes to observe, like you playing with one of her toys. Place the baby in an unsupported seated position, where she can easily watch the chosen activity. Increase the amount of time she is sitting unassisted.
instructions.zh: 选择宝宝喜欢观看的活动，例如你玩宝宝的一件玩具。让宝宝在没有支撑的坐姿中，能轻松看到这项活动。逐渐增加独自坐着的时间。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Sitting: can remain in a seated position for limited periods of time, using own arms as support.
milestone.zh: 坐姿：能用自己的手臂支撑，短时间保持坐姿。

instructions.en: Sit the baby in front of a mirror so that he can see his own image. Ask him: "Where is the baby?" or use his name.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝坐在镜子前，能看到自己的影像。问：“宝宝在哪里？”也可以用宝宝的名字来问。

materials.zh: 镜子

milestone.en: Understands the difference between a human face and non-human objects and animals.
milestone.zh: 能分辨人的脸与非人的物品和动物。

instructions.en: With the baby in front of you, repeat single syllables like "Pa," "Ma," and "Da." Then combine them to create short words, like "Papa," "Mama," or "Dada."
instructions.zh: 面对宝宝，重复单个音节，例如“Pa（帕）”“Ma（妈）”“Da（哒）”。再把音节组合成短词，例如“Papa（帕帕）”“Mama（妈妈）”“Dada（哒哒）”。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Reduplicated Babbling: repetition of the same consonant-vowel syllable (e.g., "baba," "mama"); doesn't understand meaning.
milestone.zh: 重复性咿呀学语：重复同一个辅音加元音的音节（如“baba”“mama”），还不理解含义。

instructions.en: Put the baby facing down on top of a big cylinder, like a bolster, short pool noodle, or a wide mailing tube. Hold her by her legs and push her forward until her hands touch the floor in front. Keep holding her feet and roll her back and forth a couple of times.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝面朝下趴在大圆柱体上，例如圆柱抱枕、短泡沫泳棒或宽纸筒。握住双腿，向前推到双手触地。继续握住双脚，让宝宝来回滚动几次。

materials.en: Big cylinder (i.e., rolled towel or pillow)
materials.zh: 大圆柱体，例如卷起的毛巾或枕头

instructions.en: Find a small object that will get the baby's attention, like a flashlight, finger puppet, or shiny toy. Place it in the baby's line of sight until she fixes her vision on the object; then move it slowly from side to side, up and down, and diagonally so that the baby follows it.
instructions.zh: 找一个能吸引宝宝的小物品，例如手电筒、手指偶或闪亮的玩具。放在视线内，等宝宝注视后，慢慢左右、上下和斜向移动，让宝宝追看。

materials.zh: 闪亮的玩具或手电筒

milestone.en: Deliberately turns head toward an object.
milestone.zh: 会主动转头看向物品。

instructions.en: With the baby in a seated position on your lap, get her attention with a rattle or a toy. Slowly move the toy from one side to the other, trying to increase the visual range the baby is using to track it. Repeat the process until the child follows the toy with smooth head movements in both directions.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝坐在你的腿上，用摇铃或玩具吸引注意。慢慢把玩具从一侧移到另一侧，尝试扩大宝宝追看的视野。重复到宝宝能顺畅地向两边转头追看。

materials.zh: 摇铃或玩具

milestone.en: Deliberately turns head toward an object.
milestone.zh: 会主动转头看向物品。

instructions.en: With the baby in a supported seated position, roll a ball or toy car across a table or the floor in front of him. Do it several times, first slowly and then quickly. Over time he should gain skill at tracking the object, regardless of its speed.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝在有支撑的坐姿下，观看你在前方桌面或地板上滚动球或玩具车。重复几次，先慢后快。宝宝会逐渐学会追踪物体，不受移动速度影响。

materials.zh: 球或玩具车

milestone.en: Turns head freely in both directions.
milestone.zh: 能自如地向左右两边转头。

goal.en: Reinforce the baby's understanding of its surrounding and itself
goal.zh: 增强宝宝对周围环境和自身的理解

instructions.en: Let him play naked. Encourage him to grab and explore his body parts and to take his hand and feet to his mouth.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝不穿衣服地玩耍，鼓励抓摸和探索身体部位，并把手和脚放到嘴边。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Able to put feet in mouth and suck toes.
milestone.zh: 能把脚放到嘴边并吮吸脚趾。

instructions.en: Give the baby objects that make different types of sounds, like rattles, music boxes, a small container with stones inside, or a bell. Encourage him to play with each item and make the sound himself.
instructions.zh: 给宝宝能发出不同声音的物品，例如摇铃、音乐盒、里面放有小石头的小容器或铃铛。鼓励宝宝逐个玩，并自己发出声音。

materials.en: Noisy objects (rattles, music boxes, noisy toys, small container with stones)
materials.zh: 会发声的物品，例如摇铃、音乐盒、发声玩具、装有小石头的小容器

reminder.en: Secure any container holding stones and avoid detachable small parts that could be swallowed.
reminder.zh: 原文包含装石头的容器。请确保无法打开、没有可脱落的小零件，避免吞咽。

reminderBasis: AAP：Choking Prevention

goal.en: Stimulate the concept of object permanence

instructions.en: Say the name of a toy or object that the baby is looking at; repeat the name. Once she focuses on something else, name the original object again. When she turns to you and the object, give it to her.
instructions.zh: 宝宝看着一个玩具或物品时，说出名称，并重复。宝宝转而注意别的东西后，再说一次原来物品的名称。当宝宝转向你和那个物品时，把物品给宝宝。

materials.zh: 任意玩具或物品

milestone.en: Object Permanence: is conscious that an object is partially hidden, is still there, and could reach it.
milestone.zh: 物体恒存：知道部分被遮住的物品仍然存在，并能伸手去拿。

goal.en: Stimulate the concept of object permanence

instructions.en: Put a shoelace or string through a single key that is part of a set of keys, knotting each end so that the key will not fall off the lace. Holding the shoelace vertically, let the keys drop from the top to allow the baby to follow the trajectory with his eyes. He will see that they don't disappear when dropped.
instructions.zh: 把鞋带或绳子穿过一串钥匙中的一把钥匙，两端打结，避免钥匙滑落。竖直拿着鞋带，让钥匙从上端落下，让宝宝用眼睛追踪轨迹，看到钥匙落下后仍然存在。

materials.zh: 鞋带和钥匙

milestone.en: Object Permanence: is conscious that an object is partially hidden, is still there, and could reach it.
milestone.zh: 物体恒存：知道部分被遮住的物品仍然存在，并能伸手去拿。

reminder.en: The source uses a shoelace and keys. Keep them adult-controlled and away from the mouth; prevent entanglement and review material safety.
reminder.zh: 原文使用鞋带和钥匙。绳带和钥匙只由成人控制，避免入口或缠绕；先确认材料安全。

reminderBasis: AAP：Choking Prevention；Make Baby’s Room Safe

goal.en: Stimulate the concept of object permanence

instructions.en: Get your baby engaged with a toy. Once he is playing, take the toy from him, lift it up so he can see it and drop it on the floor. Show him your empty hands and ask him where the toy went. Help him look around until he finds it. Over time, as he finds the toy faster, you can sit in a chair with the baby on your lap to increase the distance he must search to locate the toy.
instructions.zh: 先让宝宝玩一个玩具。宝宝投入后，把玩具拿走，举到宝宝看得到的位置，再让它掉到地板上。展示空手，问玩具去了哪里，帮助宝宝寻找。宝宝找得更快后，可以坐在椅子上让宝宝坐在腿上，增加寻找的距离。

materials.zh: 玩具

milestone.en: Object Permanence: is conscious that an object is partially hidden, is still there, and could reach it.
milestone.zh: 物体恒存：知道部分被遮住的物品仍然存在，并能伸手去拿。

instructions.en: With the baby in a supported seated position, hold a toy in front of him on his right side, encouraging him to take it. Keep his right arm against his body, so that he needs to use his left to reach across to grab the toy. When he reaches the toy, let him have it and then repeat the exercise on the other side.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝有支撑地坐着，在宝宝右前方拿着一个玩具，鼓励拿取。把右臂靠在身体旁，让宝宝必须用左手跨过身体去拿。够到后把玩具给宝宝，再换另一侧重复。

materials.zh: 玩具

title.zh: 视觉扶正反应：调正头部

instructions.en: While you are sitting in a chair, place the baby so that she straddles one of your legs. You can have her face you or face outward if there is a mirror or another person in front of you. Hold her by the hips and tip her to one side. Wait a few seconds to see if she brings her head back toward the middle; if she doesn't, encourage her to do so. Do the exercise multiple times, alternating sides.
instructions.zh: 坐在椅子上，让宝宝跨坐在你的一条腿上。可以面对你；如果前方有镜子或另一个人，也可以朝外。扶住髋部，把宝宝向一侧倾斜。等几秒，观察是否把头调回中间；如果没有，鼓励宝宝这样做。两侧交替，重复多次。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Sitting: can remain in a seated position for limited periods of time, using own arms as support.
milestone.zh: 坐姿：能用自己的手臂支撑，短时间保持坐姿。

instructions.en: While you are in a vertical position, hold the baby horizontally so she is facing down. Lower her to the floor at a 45-degree angle, making sure to support her well. She should put her hands out before reaching the floor. If she doesn't do this, you can softly touch her head on the floor.
instructions.zh: 你站立时，让宝宝身体水平、面朝下，并充分支撑。以45度角慢慢向地面降低。宝宝应在接近地面前伸出双手；如果没有，原文写的是可以让宝宝的头轻轻碰到地板。

materials.zh: 柔软表面

milestone.en: Sitting: can remain in a seated position for limited periods of time, using own arms as support.
milestone.zh: 坐姿：能用自己的手臂支撑，短时间保持坐姿。

reminder.en: Pause before using this instruction. The source includes touching the baby’s head to the floor. This is a transcription, not an endorsed daily instruction; seek pediatric or pediatric physical therapy review.
reminder.zh: 先暂停照做。原文包含“让头轻碰地板”的步骤，此处只保留翻译，不将该动作列为可直接照做的日常建议。先请儿科医生或儿童物理治疗师确认。

reminderBasis: 译者针对原文的核对提示／Translator review note

goal.en: Encourage the baby to make sounds

instructions.en: Cover your face with a piece of fabric or your hands and say: "If you want to see me, talk to me." Once he makes a sound of any kind, uncover your face, smile and imitate his noise. Repeat this several times. Once he gets the idea, he will start making noises to see your face.
instructions.zh: 用布或双手遮住你的脸，说：“想看到我，就和我说话。”宝宝发出任何声音后，露出脸，微笑并模仿这个声音。重复几次，宝宝理解后，会主动发声来看到你的脸。

materials.zh: 一块布

milestone.en: Object Permanence: is conscious that an object is partially hidden, is still there, and could reach it.
milestone.zh: 物体恒存：知道部分被遮住的物品仍然存在，并能伸手去拿。

instructions.en: While on a smooth surface, place the baby facing down. Show her a toy and put it out of her reach, behind her and toward one of her hips. She should begin bending the hip and knee of the opposite side in order to reach for it. If she doesn't do this, you can help her with the movement. As she starts to move toward the toy, move it farther away, ultimately making her go in a complete circle. You can periodically give the toy to the baby and continue the exercise to keep her interested. Do the same on the other side.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝趴在光滑表面上。展示玩具，再放在宝宝后方、靠近一侧髋部但够不到的位置。宝宝会弯曲另一侧的髋和膝来够玩具；如果没有，可以帮助做动作。宝宝开始移动后，把玩具移远，最终引导转一整圈。过程中可以不时让宝宝拿到玩具，保持兴趣，再换另一侧。

materials.zh: 玩具、光滑表面

milestone.en: Rolling and Moving: able to roll over, turn, and pivot in all directions.
milestone.zh: 翻身和移动：能翻身、转动身体，并向各方向转向。

goal.en: Increase the baby's awareness of its hands and fingers
goal.zh: 增强宝宝对手和手指的认识

instructions.en: Play various games, trying to draw the baby's attention to each finger. For example, count from 1 to 10 grabbing each finger, or sing songs like "Where is Thumper?"
instructions.zh: 玩各种能让宝宝注意每根手指的游戏。例如，逐个握住手指从1数到10，或唱“Where is Thumper?”这类手指歌。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Gets excited when realizes that it is playtime.
milestone.zh: 意识到要玩耍时表现出兴奋。

instructions.en: Find several toys that move on their own after performing a specific action. For example, a pullback car or a windup toy. Demonstrate to the baby how the toys work and then let him try to use them by himself.
instructions.zh: 找几种做特定动作后会自己移动的玩具，例如回力车或上发条的玩具。先演示如何使用，再让宝宝自己试。

materials.zh: 能移动的机械玩具

goal.en: Strengthen arm, back, and chest muscles
goal.zh: 增强手臂、背部和胸部肌肉

instructions.en: With the baby lying face down on your lap with his chest on one leg, hold a toy just above his head and encourage him to look at it. He will need to lift his head and chest with his arms to see it, arching his back in the process.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝面朝下趴在你的腿上，胸口放在其中一条腿上。把玩具举在头部稍上方，鼓励宝宝看。宝宝需要用手臂撑起头和胸口，并拱起背部，才能看到玩具。

materials.zh: 玩具

milestone.en: Core Strength: lying face down, can adopt a superman-like position (arms and knees lifted, back arched).
milestone.zh: 核心力量：趴着时能做出类似超人的姿势，抬起手臂和膝盖、背部拱起。

goal.en: Strengthen arm, back, and chest muscles
goal.zh: 增强手臂、背部和胸部肌肉

instructions.en: Lay the baby face down on the floor or your bed. Hold a toy in front of him, high enough that he has to lift up his head and chest to see it. Encourage him to push his upper body with his arms so that he can see the toy. Over time he will be able to hold the position for increasing amounts of time.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝趴在地板或床上。在前方把玩具举到需要抬头和抬胸才能看到的高度，鼓励用双臂撑起上半身。宝宝会逐渐能保持更长时间。

materials.zh: 玩具

milestone.en: Able to lift chest up with arms when prone.
milestone.zh: 趴着时能用手臂撑起胸部。

goal.en: Strengthen arm, back, and chest muscles
goal.zh: 增强手臂、背部和胸部肌肉

instructions.en: Place the baby on the floor face down, with her arms fully extended, lifting her chest and head. Hold a toy within her reach at her shoulder level or higher, encouraging her to reach for the toy. The baby will put all of her weight on one arm while she reaches out for the toy with the other hand.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝趴在地板上，双臂伸直，撑起头和胸口。在能够够到、与肩同高或更高的位置拿着玩具，鼓励伸手。宝宝会用一只手臂承重，另一只手去够玩具。

materials.zh: 玩具

milestone.en: Able to lift chest up with arms when prone.
milestone.zh: 趴着时能用手臂撑起胸部。

goal.zh: 把声音与特定事件联系起来

instructions.en: Show him how to turn on and off a radio or other music source. Let him try it and act excited if he succeeds.
instructions.zh: 演示如何打开和关闭收音机或其他音乐播放器。让宝宝试试，成功时表现出开心和兴奋。

materials.zh: 收音机或其他音乐播放器

milestone.en: High level of interest in toys that produce sounds like bells, music boxes and rattles.
milestone.zh: 对铃铛、音乐盒、摇铃等发声玩具很感兴趣。

goal.en: Improve ability to get to a sitting position

instructions.en: When the baby is in a seated position, shift her slightly to one side, so that her weight is on her hands or arms. Ideally she will return to a sitting position by herself, but you may need to guide her the first few times. Repeat in all directions. As she improves, you can move her to a lying down position, helping her sit from there.
instructions.zh: 宝宝坐着时，稍微向一侧倾斜，使重量落在手或手臂上。理想情况下，宝宝会自行回到坐姿；开始几次可能需要引导。各个方向都练习。能力提高后，可以从躺姿开始，帮助回到坐姿。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Sitting: can remain in a seated position for limited periods of time, using own arms as support.
milestone.zh: 坐姿：能用自己的手臂支撑，短时间保持坐姿。

instructions.en: With the baby facing down, show her one of her favorite toys and slowly lift it approximately 6 inches above her head, with the toy still visible to her. Encourage her to reach for it using one hand.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝面朝下，展示喜欢的玩具，再慢慢举到头部上方约6英寸（约15厘米），始终让宝宝看得到。鼓励宝宝用一只手去够。

materials.zh: 玩具

instructions.en: While your baby is in a sitting position in front of you, with or without support, move her forward and backward and then from side to side holding her by her hands or using a bar. This will improve her equilibrium.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝坐在你面前，可以有支撑，也可以没有。握住双手或借助一根杆，带宝宝前后、左右移动，帮助改善平衡。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Sitting: can remain in a seated position for limited periods of time, using own arms as support.
milestone.zh: 坐姿：能用自己的手臂支撑，短时间保持坐姿。

goal.en: Familiarize the baby with the characteristics of sound: timbre, tone, and movement
goal.zh: 让宝宝熟悉声音的音色、音调和变化

instructions.en: Recite short, simple poems with strong rhythm. Nursery rhymes and Dr. Seuss books are great sources. While the complexity and length of the poems will increase, you should continue to perform this activity frequently for as long as you can. Reading has multiple significant benefits for your child.
instructions.zh: 朗读简短、节奏鲜明的诗歌，可以选择童谣或苏斯博士的书。随着宝宝成长，逐渐增加诗歌的复杂程度和长度，并尽可能长期经常进行。阅读对宝宝有多方面的益处。

materials.zh: 童谣

instructions.en: Place the baby on her back. Bend one leg and, holding that knee, pull the leg across her body, over the straight leg until it touches the floor. This will cause her to roll over. Repeat on the other side.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝仰卧，弯曲一条腿，握住那侧膝盖，把弯曲的腿带过身体和伸直的另一条腿，直到碰到地板，带动宝宝翻身。再换另一侧。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Rolling and Moving: able to roll over, turn, and pivot in all directions.
milestone.zh: 翻身和移动：能翻身、转动身体，并向各方向转向。

instructions.en: Once the baby has started rolling, use a toy or group of toys to encourage him to roll a longer distance by rolling multiple times in a row.
instructions.zh: 宝宝开始会翻身后，用一个或一组玩具吸引连续翻身，逐渐翻过更长的距离。

materials.zh: 玩具、开阔表面

milestone.en: Rolling and Moving: able to roll over, turn, and pivot in all directions.
milestone.zh: 翻身和移动：能翻身、转动身体，并向各方向转向。

instructions.en: Place a flat pillow or folded blanket on the floor and put your baby face down on it, with one side of her body remaining on the floor. Because her body is not level, she should attempt to roll to straighten herself out. Repeat on the other side.
instructions.zh: 在地板上放一个扁枕头或折好的毯子，让宝宝趴在上面，身体一侧仍留在地板上。因为身体不在同一高度，宝宝会尝试翻身来调整姿势。再换另一侧。

materials.zh: 扁枕头或毯子

milestone.en: Rolling and Moving: able to roll over, turn, and pivot in all directions.
milestone.zh: 翻身和移动：能翻身、转动身体，并向各方向转向。

goal.en: Expand the baby's capacity to follow moving objects
goal.zh: 提高宝宝追踪移动物体的能力

instructions.en: Roll a ball while trying to have the baby follow it visually. Then let her play with it.
instructions.zh: 滚动一个球，尝试让宝宝用眼睛追看，然后让宝宝玩球。

materials.zh: 球

milestone.en: Turns head freely in both directions.
milestone.zh: 能自如地向左右两边转头。

instructions.en: Frequently call the baby by name when you are a few feet away.
instructions.zh: 在距离宝宝几英尺的位置，经常叫宝宝的名字。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

goal.zh: 提高组合多个动作的能力

instructions.en: With the baby lying down or in a supported seated position, hold a toy or rattle in front of him, close enough that he can grab it. Demonstrate how to grab it from you, putting it into his hand. Eventually he will take the toy on his own.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝躺着或在有支撑的坐姿下，把玩具或摇铃拿在前方，近到可以抓住。把玩具放进宝宝手中，演示如何从你手里拿走。宝宝最终会自己拿。

materials.zh: 玩具或摇铃

milestone.en: Eye-Body Coordination: increased capability (e.g., looks at an object and tries to reach it).
milestone.zh: 眼与身体协调增强，例如看着物品并尝试伸手够到。

instructions.en: Let the baby play in the bathtub. Fill it with different baby-safe substances like water, shaving cream, sand, foam blocks, or plastic balls.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝在浴盆里玩。原文列出水、剃须泡沫、沙子、泡沫积木和塑料球等不同材料，并称它们为适合宝宝的材料。

materials.zh: 沙子、积木、水等

reminder.en: Maintain close, continuous supervision; never leave the baby alone in a tub. Do not assume shaving cream or sand is suitable for a 7-month-old; review materials and avoid ingestion and small parts.
reminder.zh: 全程保持近距离看护，不能让宝宝独自在浴盆中。原文列出的剃须泡沫、沙子等不应直接视为适合7个月宝宝的材料，请先确认；避免入口和可吞咽的小物。

reminderBasis: AAP：Bathroom Safety；Choking Prevention；材料适用性为译者核对提示

goal.en: Improve balance and prepare for sitting
goal.zh: 改善平衡，为坐姿做准备

instructions.en: Lie down on the floor with the baby lying on top of you, with her legs placed over your torso and her torso on your legs. Hold her by the hands and raise your chest so that her torso is horizontal with the floor and her legs are vertical. Then alternate the movement by raising your legs and lowering your torso to the ground like a human rocking horse.
instructions.zh: 你躺在地板上，让宝宝躺在你身上：宝宝的双腿放在你的躯干上，躯干放在你的双腿上。握住宝宝双手，抬起你的上半身，使宝宝躯干与地板平行、双腿竖直。再抬起你的双腿并把你的上半身放回地面，交替动作，像人体摇摇马。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Able to stay in a sitting position for a few seconds without assistance.
milestone.zh: 不用帮助，也能保持坐姿几秒钟。

reminder.en: Pause before using the source’s hand-held rocking movement. Do not pull or lift the baby by the hands or wrists; seek pediatric review.
reminder.zh: 先暂停照做。原文涉及握住双手并摇动身体；不要通过手或手腕提拉宝宝，先请儿科专业人员确认。

reminderBasis: AAP：Nursemaid’s Elbow

goal.en: Differentiate sounds with different tone, timbre, and rhythm
goal.zh: 分辨不同音调、音色和节奏的声音

instructions.en: Sing songs and move him to the rhythm of the song, trying to imitate different voices and volumes in the song.
instructions.zh: 唱歌，并随着节奏带动宝宝，尝试模仿歌曲中不同的声音和音量。

materials.zh: 音乐、摇篮曲

instructions.en: Place the baby on a soft surface, like a mattress or pillows, and give her a small bar to grab. When you are sure that she has a solid grip, raise her slowly. Once you have raised her a few inches, encourage her to continue lifting her chest until she reaches a sitting position. This is likely to take some practice, so do not expect her to go all the way to sitting position the first time. Once she has reached her maximum point for that session, help her back slowly until she releases the bar. Sing an encouraging song while repeating the exercise a few times.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝躺在柔软表面上，例如床垫或枕头，给一根小杆抓住。确认抓稳后，慢慢抬起几英寸，鼓励宝宝继续抬胸直到坐起。可能需要多次练习，不必期待第一次就完全坐起来。达到这次能做到的最高位置后，慢慢帮助躺回去，直到松开小杆。重复几次，并唱歌鼓励。

materials.zh: 小杆

milestone.en: Able to reach a sitting position from lying on back, using similar movements to rolling (between months 6 and 8).
milestone.zh: 能从仰卧转为坐姿，动作类似翻身（约6–8个月）。

reminder.en: Pause before lifting the baby while gripping a bar; this may pull through the arms. Seek pediatric or pediatric physical therapy review.
reminder.zh: 先暂停照做。原文让宝宝握杆后被抬起，存在通过手臂提拉的问题，请先让儿科医生或儿童物理治疗师确认。

reminderBasis: AAP：Nursemaid’s Elbow；适用性判断为译者提示

instructions.en: With your baby lying on her back, insert a pillow under her back and head so that she is raised 20-30 degrees. Hold one of her favorite toys in front of her. The position will allow the baby to reach the sitting position more easily. You can provide assistance at the beginning, if necessary.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝仰卧，在背部和头部下垫一个枕头，抬高20–30度。把喜欢的玩具拿在前方，这个姿势有助于更容易坐起。开始时可按需要提供帮助。

materials.zh: 玩具

milestone.en: Able to reach a sitting position from lying on back, using similar movements to rolling (between months 6 and 8).
milestone.zh: 能从仰卧转为坐姿，动作类似翻身（约6–8个月）。

goal.en: Stimulate the baby's sense of smell

instructions.en: When cooking or preparing meals, introduce different scents and flavors to the baby. As you let him smell and taste, say the name of each food.
instructions.zh: 做饭或准备食物时，让宝宝接触不同气味和味道。闻和尝的时候，说出每种食物的名称。

materials.zh: 用餐准备的食物

goal.zh: 把声音与特定事件联系起来

instructions.en: Hide one of his favorite toys. Show him the toy and ring a bell or make another sound at the same time. After he has seen the toy, play a completely different sound and hide the toy. Repeat the sequence, always revealing the toy with one sound and hiding it with another. After a few times, the baby will begin to associate the sounds with the different actions.
instructions.zh: 藏起喜欢的玩具。展示玩具时同时摇铃或发出一种声音；展示之后，换成完全不同的声音，并把玩具藏起来。重复这个顺序，始终用一种声音表示出现，另一种表示隐藏。几次之后，宝宝会开始把声音和动作联系起来。

materials.zh: 玩具和两种声音来源

milestone.en: Remembers own actions in the immediate past.
milestone.zh: 记得刚刚做过的动作。

instructions.en: Let the baby play with toys that make a sound when squeezed. Teach him how squeezing the toy makes a sound.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝玩一捏就会响的玩具，教宝宝认识“捏玩具就会发出声音”。

materials.en: Toys that make a sound when squeezed
materials.zh: 捏压时会发声的玩具

instructions.en: Hold the baby vertically with her feet on the floor; gently bounce her until her muscles engage and she takes some of the weight on her own. Reduce your support so that she engages more, but continue holding on to her waist to provide additional support.
instructions.zh: 竖直抱住宝宝，让双脚接触地板。轻轻上下弹动，直到腿部肌肉参与并承受一部分重量。逐渐减少支撑，让宝宝更多参与，但始终扶住腰部，提供额外支持。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

instructions.en: With the baby facing up, hold her under her armpits with your thumbs on her chest and other fingers holding her back. Slowly lift her, trying to maintain a horizontal position. The baby will react by arching her back and stretching her legs and arms.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝面朝上，从腋下托住，拇指放在胸前，其他手指托住背部。慢慢抬起，尽量保持身体水平。宝宝会通过拱背、伸直双腿和双臂作出反应。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

instructions.en: Talk to your baby while you are walking away from him, continuing to speak when you are no longer visible. Then come back slowly while still talking to him. He will realize that the sound continues even if he can't see you and will begin to understand that volume varies with the distance.
instructions.zh: 一边和宝宝说话，一边走远；离开视线后仍继续说话。然后慢慢走回来，始终说着话。宝宝会发现看不到你时，声音仍在，并开始理解音量会随距离变化。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Object Permanence: is conscious that an object is partially hidden, is still there, and could reach it.
milestone.zh: 物体恒存：知道部分被遮住的物品仍然存在，并能伸手去拿。

goal.en: Teaching the concept of stopping an action
goal.zh: 教授停止某个动作的概念

instructions.en: Whenever you need to establish a limit, say, "No," while shaking your head and finger. Explain exactly what it is you do not want the baby to do.
instructions.zh: 需要设定界限时，说“不”，同时摇头并摆动手指。具体解释不希望宝宝做什么。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Knows "No": starting to understand the meaning of "no" by recognizing the tone of the voice.
milestone.zh: 理解“不”：开始根据语气理解“不”的含义。

instructions.en: Have your baby spend time on his tummy while he is awake. Tummy time should be repeated multiple times a day, starting with a few minutes at a time. As the baby becomes more comfortable, you can increase the time for each session.
instructions.zh: 宝宝清醒时，让宝宝趴着玩。每天重复多次，开始每次几分钟。宝宝越来越适应后，可以增加每次的时间。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Front to Back Roll: when face-down, might be able to move side to side until rolls over onto back (between months 4 and 5).
milestone.zh: 从趴着翻到仰卧：趴着时可能会左右移动，直到翻成仰卧（约4–5个月）。

reminder.en: Tummy time is for awake, supervised play; place the baby on the back for sleep.
reminder.zh: 趴着玩仅限清醒并有成人看护时；睡觉时仍应仰卧。

reminderBasis: AAP：Back to Sleep, Tummy to Play

instructions.en: Point to objects and call them by their complete name.
instructions.zh: 指着物品，说出它们的完整名称。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Reduplicated Babbling: repetition of the same consonant-vowel syllable (e.g., "baba," "mama"); doesn't understand meaning.
milestone.zh: 重复性咿呀学语：重复同一个辅音加元音的音节（如“baba”“mama”），还不理解含义。

goal.en: Expand the baby's capacity to follow moving objects
goal.zh: 提高宝宝追踪移动物体的能力

instructions.en: Put the baby close to a window where he can watch cars or people passing by.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝靠近窗户，观看经过的车辆或行人。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Turns head freely in both directions.
milestone.zh: 能自如地向左右两边转头。

instructions.en: While slowly saying "Yes, no, yes..." nod and shake your head to demonstrate what you are saying. Do this until the baby starts to imitate your movements.
instructions.zh: 慢慢说“是、不、是……”时，配合点头和摇头，演示所说的意思。持续进行，直到宝宝开始模仿。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Imitation: purposely tries to mimic simple sounds and movements.
milestone.zh: 模仿：有意识地尝试模仿简单声音和动作。

goal.en: Developing the concept of yes and no

instructions.en: Show the baby things she can touch, while nodding your head and saying, "Yes." Do the same with things she can't touch, shaking your head and saying, "No." Do this with other actions you want to reinforce as allowed or prohibited.
instructions.zh: 展示宝宝可以触摸的东西，同时点头并说“可以”。再展示不能触摸的东西，同时摇头说“不可以”。也用其他你希望强化为允许或禁止的动作进行练习。

materials.en: A few toys and a few objects that are inappropriate for babies (e.g., scissors or a butter knife)
materials.zh: 几个玩具，以及几个不适合宝宝的物品；原文举例为剪刀或餐刀

milestone.en: Knows "No": starting to understand the meaning of "no" by recognizing the tone of the voice.
milestone.zh: 理解“不”：开始根据语气理解“不”的含义。

reminder.en: The source mentions scissors and a butter knife. Do not hand these to the baby; keep them adult-controlled and out of reach.
reminder.zh: 原文举例包括剪刀和餐刀。请不要把这些物品交给宝宝；演示时由成人保管并放在宝宝够不到的位置。

reminderBasis: 译者针对原文的核对提示／Translator review note

goal.zh: 把声音与具体物品联系起来

instructions.en: Whenever you see an airplane, show it to him and say "Airplane." Then imitate the noise that an airplane makes and say again "Airplane." Also do this with animals and anything else that you can associate with a specific sound.
instructions.zh: 看到飞机时，指给宝宝看并说“飞机”。模仿飞机的声音，再说一次“飞机”。对动物及其他能对应特定声音的事物，也这样做。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Attempts to imitate noises or sounds produced by objects (e.g., "boom!").
milestone.zh: 尝试模仿物品发出的声音，例如“砰！”。

title.zh: 预期事件 II：准备穿衣

instructions.en: When dressing the baby, encourage her to raise her arms when it is time to put on her shirt. Over time, she will start to raise her arms in anticipation when you simply hold the shirt up. When she does this, praise her.
instructions.zh: 给宝宝穿衣时，到了穿上衣的步骤，鼓励宝宝抬起双臂。慢慢地，只要你举起上衣，宝宝就会预先抬手。宝宝这样做时，要给予表扬。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

duration.zh: 给宝宝穿衣或脱衣时进行

milestone.en: While getting dressed, increasingly helps by moving and preparing his arms and legs as needed.
milestone.zh: 穿衣时越来越会配合，根据需要移动和准备双臂、双腿。

title.zh: 预期事件 III：理解先后顺序

goal.en: Learning to use clues to anticipate future events
goal.zh: 学习利用线索预期接下来发生的事

instructions.en: Help your baby understand that some activities require others in order to happen. For example, selecting clothes has to happen before getting dressed; opening a container and pouring food into a bowl or onto a plate has to happen before eating. Explain what you are doing as you are doing it.
instructions.zh: 帮助宝宝理解，有些活动要先完成其他步骤才能进行。例如，先选好衣服再穿衣；先打开容器，把食物倒进碗或盘子，再吃东西。边做边解释你正在做什么。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: While getting dressed, increasingly helps by moving and preparing his arms and legs as needed.
milestone.zh: 穿衣时越来越会配合，根据需要移动和准备双臂、双腿。

instructions.en: Whenever she repeats any sound multiple times, like "Ma ma" or "Ba ba," or puts two sounds together, like "Ma ba" or "Da ma," show enthusiasm and tell her how excited you are.
instructions.zh: 宝宝重复同一种声音，例如“ma ma”“ba ba”，或把两种声音组合起来，例如“ma ba”“da ma”时，热情回应，并告诉宝宝你很开心。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Expands variety of consonant-vowel syllables, but often repeats the same syllable multiple times before moving to another.
milestone.zh: 能发出更多辅音加元音的音节，但常重复同一音节多次后再换另一个。

instructions.en: Have the baby hold a toy in each hand, like blocks, maracas, or small balls. Show him how to bang them together.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝两只手各拿一个玩具，例如积木、沙锤或小球。示范怎样把它们相互敲碰。

materials.zh: 积木、沙锤或小球

milestone.en: Grasping Objects: can hold two objects simultaneously, one in each hand; can bang them together.
milestone.zh: 抓握物品：两只手能同时各拿一个物品，并把它们相互敲碰。

goal.en: Learning to call someone close to the baby

instructions.en: Whenever you and the baby are with close friends and family, encourage the baby to call an adult's attention. Show him how to do it and encourage him to do it himself. Once he makes sounds or otherwise tries to call the adult, the adult should come over to the baby and thank him for calling so nicely. Repeat this exercise every time you have an opportunity until he learns to do it on his own.
instructions.zh: 和宝宝一起与亲友相处时，鼓励宝宝吸引一位成人的注意。先示范，再鼓励宝宝自己试。宝宝发声或以其他方式尝试呼唤时，那位成人就走过来，感谢宝宝叫得这么好。每次有机会都重复，直到宝宝能自己做到。

materials.en: 2 adults close to the baby present
materials.zh: 两位宝宝熟悉的成人在场

milestone.en: Variegated Babbling: more sophisticated form of babbling that combines different consonant-vowel syllables instead of repeating the same one.
milestone.zh: 多样性咿呀学语：把不同的辅音加元音音节组合起来，而不只是重复同一个音节。

goal.en: Teach the baby to call Dad

instructions.en: While one parent is holding the baby ask the other one to sit in front of both of you and cover their face with a magazine. Ask the baby "Where is Dada?" or "Where is Mama?" encouraging her to say "Dada" or "Mama." Once she says it, the parent will uncover their face and say in a happy tone "Here's Dada" or "Here's Mama!" Repeat this exercise, changing the object behind which the parent is hiding.
instructions.zh: 一位家长抱着宝宝，另一位坐在你们面前，用杂志遮住脸。问宝宝“爸爸在哪里？”或“妈妈在哪里？”，鼓励宝宝说“爸爸”或“妈妈”。宝宝说出后，家长露出脸，高兴地说“爸爸在这里！”或“妈妈在这里！”。重复练习，并更换遮脸的物品。

materials.zh: 杂志、报纸

milestone.en: Enjoys Peek-a-boo style games.
milestone.zh: 喜欢躲猫猫类游戏。

instructions.en: Find two pieces of similarly sized thin cardboard and glue sand or rice onto one of the pieces to create a rough texture and let it dry. Give the plain one to the baby and let him play with it, bending it, tearing it, folding it, or whatever else he wants to do. Then take the other piece and have him feel the new texture, explaining: "This is rice, it is rough." Reintroduce the first piece and explain that it is smooth. Let him play with the rough piece to manipulate it in the same way that he did the first.
instructions.zh: 找两块大小相近的薄纸板，在其中一块上粘沙子或米，形成粗糙表面，等胶水干透。先把光滑的一块给宝宝，让宝宝弯折、撕、折叠或自由探索。再让宝宝摸粗糙的一块，解释“这是米，摸起来粗糙”。重新拿出第一块，说明它是光滑的。让宝宝用同样的方法探索粗糙纸板。

materials.en: 2 pieces of thin cardboard, glue, sand or rice
materials.zh: 两块薄纸板、胶水、沙子或米

reminder.en: The source uses sand or rice glued to cardboard. Prevent mouthing and remove loose particles or scraps.
reminder.zh: 原文使用粘有沙子或米的纸板。不要让宝宝把材料放入口中；如颗粒或纸屑脱落，立即收起。

reminderBasis: 译者材料核对提示／Translator material review note

instructions.en: Grab the baby by her wrists and show her how to clap her own hands. Repeat it frequently until she starts doing it by herself. Celebrate by clapping your own hands or singing, "If you're happy and you know it, clap your hands!"
instructions.zh: 握住宝宝的手腕，示范怎样拍自己的双手。经常重复，直到宝宝能自己拍手。你也拍手或唱“如果感到幸福你就拍拍手”，表示鼓励。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Claps energetically and moves hands around to express excitement while seated.
milestone.zh: 坐着时，会用力拍手、挥动双手来表达兴奋。

instructions.en: Get three blocks, one larger than the other two. Give the baby a small block and let him play with it for a little bit. Then give him the larger block and let him play with it as well. Give him the third block and say: "Look, we have 1, 2, 3 blocks." Once he starts losing interest, line them up in front of him, point to the bigger block and say: "This one is different, it is bigger."
instructions.zh: 准备三块积木，其中一块比另两块大。先给宝宝一块小积木玩一会儿，再给大积木。给第三块时说“看，我们有1、2、3块积木”。宝宝开始失去兴趣时，把积木排在面前，指着大的说“这块不一样，它更大”。

materials.zh: 三块积木，其中一块比另两块大

instructions.en: Give her a container with small objects, raisins, or Cheerios. Help her spill them on the floor or a table and encourage her to put them back in the container.
instructions.zh: 给宝宝一个装有小物品、葡萄干或圈形谷物麦片的容器。帮助宝宝把它们倒到地板或桌上，再鼓励宝宝放回容器里。

materials.en: Jar with small objects or food
materials.zh: 装有小物品或食物的罐子

milestone.en: Radial Digital Grasp: grasps objects using index finger, middle finger and thumb.
milestone.zh: 桡侧手指抓握：用食指、中指和拇指抓物品。

reminder.en: The source’s raisins and small objects pose choking risks. Review materials and food preparation for the baby’s skills; supervise eating while seated upright.
reminder.zh: 原文的葡萄干和小物品有噎住风险，不直接照用。请先按宝宝咀嚼、吞咽能力确认食物或材料，进食时坐直并全程看护。

reminderBasis: CDC：Choking Hazards

instructions.en: Fill a container with small objects or food, like raisins or Cheerios. With the baby sitting next to you, empty the container onto a table or the floor and pick up each object, one at a time and hold it between your fingers. You want the baby to grab the item from your fingers and place it in the container. You can first explain what you want her to do, and then demonstrate.
instructions.zh: 把小物品或食物，例如葡萄干或圈形谷物麦片，放进容器。宝宝坐在身边时，把它们倒到桌上或地板上。逐个捡起，用手指拿着，让宝宝从你手中取走并放回容器。可先解释要做什么，再示范。

materials.zh: 装有葡萄干或圈形谷物麦片的容器

milestone.en: Radial Digital Grasp: grasps objects using index finger, middle finger and thumb.
milestone.zh: 桡侧手指抓握：用食指、中指和拇指抓物品。

reminder.en: Review the source’s raisins and small objects for choking risk; supervise eating while seated upright.
reminder.zh: 原文的葡萄干和小物品有噎住风险，不直接照用。请先确认材料与食物适用性，进食时坐直并全程看护。

reminderBasis: CDC：Choking Hazards

instructions.en: Have the baby touch a piece of ice while saying, "Cold." Immediately afterwards, repeat the exercise with warm water and say: "Hot."
instructions.zh: 让宝宝碰一小块冰，同时说“冷”。紧接着用温水重复，嘴里说“热”。

materials.zh: 冰、温水

instructions.en: Hold the baby in front of a set of stairs and encourage him to crawl up the first few steps. Hold him and help him until he is able to do it by himself, which is likely to happen after he is 9 months old.
instructions.zh: 在楼梯前扶住宝宝，鼓励宝宝爬上最初几级台阶。扶着并帮助宝宝，直到宝宝能自己做到；原文说明，这通常要到9个月以后。

materials.zh: 楼梯

milestone.en: As baby transitions to proper crawling, may sway forward and backward in crawling position without actually moving.
milestone.zh: 开始学习正式爬行时，可能在爬行姿势中前后摇晃，却还没有向前移动。

instructions.en: Find a low step, stool, or sturdy box and help the baby to climb or crawl on top of the object. Initially, she will just lean on it with her arms, so you will need to show her that by raising her leg enough she can use her knee as leverage to lift up her second knee. Gradually, she will learn to climb it on her own.
instructions.zh: 找一处低台阶、矮凳或结实的箱子，帮助宝宝爬上去。起初宝宝可能只用双臂靠着它，需要示范：把腿抬高，将一个膝盖放上去，再借力抬起另一个膝盖。宝宝会逐渐学会自己爬上去。

materials.en: Low step, stool or sturdy box
materials.zh: 低台阶、矮凳或结实的箱子

milestone.en: Crawling: able to crawl (between months 8-10); can do it forward or backward at the beginning.
milestone.zh: 爬行：约8–10个月能爬，最初可能向前或向后爬。

instructions.en: With the baby facing down, put one of her favorite toys in front of her, at least a foot or two away. Then help her to get into a crawling position. Help to move her legs as if she were crawling, alternating with moving her hands so that she doesn't fall down. When she reaches the toy, celebrate it enthusiastically.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝趴着，把喜欢的玩具放在面前，至少距离约30–60厘米。帮助宝宝摆出爬行姿势，再交替帮助腿和手做爬行动作，避免倒下。宝宝到达玩具时，热情庆祝。

materials.zh: 玩具

milestone.en: As baby transitions to proper crawling, may sway forward and backward in crawling position without actually moving.
milestone.zh: 开始学习正式爬行时，可能在爬行姿势中前后摇晃，却还没有向前移动。

instructions.en: Sit down with your legs extended and put the baby by your side, with her chest resting on your leg. On the other side of your opposite leg, put one of her favorite toys. Try to encourage the baby to crawl over your legs to reach the toy. If necessary give her a hand by pushing her from her legs or buttocks.
instructions.zh: 坐下并伸直双腿，让宝宝在身侧，胸部搭在你的一条腿上。在另一条腿外侧放一个喜欢的玩具，鼓励宝宝爬过你的双腿去拿。如果需要，可从宝宝腿部或臀部轻推，给予帮助。

materials.zh: 玩具

milestone.en: As baby transitions to proper crawling, may sway forward and backward in crawling position without actually moving.
milestone.zh: 开始学习正式爬行时，可能在爬行姿势中前后摇晃，却还没有向前移动。

title.zh: 爬行 III：用布支撑胸部

instructions.en: With your baby on the floor facing down, take a blanket or a scarf and place it under the baby's chest. Grab both sides of the fabric and lift his chest 5 to 7 inches off the ground, so that he is in crawling position. Continue to support him, encouraging him to crawl forward; use a toy as motivation if necessary.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝在地板上趴着，把毯子或围巾放在胸部下方。握住布的两端，把胸部抬离地面约13–18厘米，让宝宝处于爬行姿势。继续支撑，鼓励宝宝向前爬；需要时用玩具吸引。

materials.zh: 一块宽布

milestone.en: As baby transitions to proper crawling, may sway forward and backward in crawling position without actually moving.
milestone.zh: 开始学习正式爬行时，可能在爬行姿势中前后摇晃，却还没有向前移动。

instructions.en: You and another person sit next to each other with legs straight and slightly open. Using the legs as an obstacle for the baby, put the baby's chest on the first leg and one of her favorite toys on the outside of the fourth leg. Encourage her to crawl over each leg until she reaches the toy on the other side.
instructions.zh: 你和另一位成人并排坐下，双腿伸直并略分开。把你们的腿作为障碍，让宝宝胸部搭在第一条腿上，在第四条腿外侧放喜欢的玩具。鼓励宝宝依次爬过每条腿，到另一边拿玩具。

materials.zh: 玩具、另一位成人

milestone.en: Crawling: able to crawl (between months 8-10); can do it forward or backward at the beginning.
milestone.zh: 爬行：约8–10个月能爬，最初可能向前或向后爬。

instructions.en: In an open space, distribute various objects like boxes, chairs, and small tables around the floor. Space them out and put a favorite toy at the end. The idea is to have the baby crawl around, through or under the obstacles to get to the toy. Start by helping her crawl through the biggest spaces. For example, you can place two boxes a few feet apart and have her crawl between them. Gradually, decrease the size of the space as her skills improve and she learns to protect her head. This exercise is very good for her back muscles.
instructions.zh: 在开阔处把箱子、椅子、小桌等放在地上，彼此留出间隔，终点放喜欢的玩具。鼓励宝宝绕过、穿过或钻过障碍去拿玩具。先帮助宝宝通过较宽的空隙，例如相隔几英尺的两个箱子之间。随着能力提高、学会保护头部，再逐渐缩小空隙。原文说明，这有助于锻炼背部肌肉。

materials.en: Various large obstacles - i.e., chairs, boxes, tables, baskets, etc.
materials.zh: 较大的障碍物，例如椅子、箱子、桌子、篮子等

milestone.en: Crawling: able to crawl (between months 8-10); can do it forward or backward at the beginning.
milestone.zh: 爬行：约8–10个月能爬，最初可能向前或向后爬。

goal.en: Improve ability to manipulate an object

instructions.en: Find a piece of aluminum foil and help the baby crumple it into a loose ball.
instructions.zh: 找一张铝箔，帮助宝宝把它揉成一个松松的球。

materials.zh: 铝箔

milestone.en: Uses hands in different ways; for example, uses one as support and the other to manipulate an object.
milestone.zh: 双手能分工使用，例如一只手支撑，另一只手操作物品。

instructions.en: Play different types of music for your baby. Dance with him to the different rhythms, telling him when you are moving quickly or slowly.
instructions.zh: 给宝宝播放不同类型的音乐，抱着宝宝按不同节奏跳舞。告诉宝宝什么时候动得快、什么时候动得慢。

materials.zh: 音乐

milestone.en: Listens carefully to conversations and songs, understanding the difference in tones.
milestone.zh: 仔细听交谈和歌曲，能理解音调的不同。

instructions.en: Say a phrase to the baby, first using a high pitch tone, then a low tone. Repeat this exercise frequently.
instructions.zh: 对宝宝说一句话，先用高音，再用低音。经常重复这个练习。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Listens carefully to conversations and songs, understanding the difference in tones.
milestone.zh: 仔细听交谈和歌曲，能理解音调的不同。

goal.en: Differentiate between high and low volume

instructions.en: Say something to your baby using your normal conversational voice. Then get closer to her and whisper the same phrase. Move away and repeat the same sentence, but much louder.
instructions.zh: 先用平常交谈的音量对宝宝说一句话，再靠近宝宝，小声耳语同一句话。接着远离一些，用更大的声音重复。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Listens carefully to conversations and songs, understanding the difference in tones.
milestone.zh: 仔细听交谈和歌曲，能理解音调的不同。

instructions.en: Take an empty plastic cup and give another one to your baby. Pretend that you are drinking from the cup and try to get the baby to imitate you. Encourage her, as she gets closer to doing it correctly.
instructions.zh: 自己拿一个空塑料杯，也给宝宝一个。假装用杯子喝水，鼓励宝宝模仿。宝宝动作越来越接近正确方式时，给予鼓励。

materials.zh: 两个杯子

instructions.en: If you haven't yet introduced a sippy cup, now is a good time to start. Try a few kinds of cups to see which type your child prefers, making sure you use one with a top to start. Place a small amount of water, milk, or juice into the cup and hand it to the child; place your hands over hers and guide the cup to her mouth.
instructions.zh: 如果还没开始使用学饮杯，可以开始尝试。试几种杯子，看看宝宝更喜欢哪一种，最初用带盖的。在杯中放少量水、奶或果汁，递给宝宝。把你的手覆在宝宝手上，引导杯子到嘴边。

materials.zh: 学饮杯

reminder.en: The source mentions juice. AAP recommends no juice before 12 months unless clinically indicated. The source does not specify the type of milk.
reminder.zh: 原文列出果汁。AAP建议未满12个月不要喝果汁，除非有临床需要；原文“奶”未说明种类，不能据此改用牛奶。

reminderBasis: AAP：Fruit Juice Recommendations；奶的原文歧义为译者提示

instructions.en: Encourage the baby to drop objects into containers of various sizes. Start with larger containers with wide mouths and then gradually decrease to more narrow openings. You can use boxes, bowls, kitchen canisters and then move to water bottles and soda bottles. Similarly, start with larger objects, like stuffed animals, balls, and blocks and move to smaller items.
instructions.zh: 鼓励宝宝把物品放进不同大小的容器。先用开口宽的大容器，再逐渐换成开口较窄的。可从箱子、碗、厨房储物罐开始，再换成水瓶或汽水瓶。物品也从毛绒玩具、球、积木等较大的，逐渐换成较小的。

materials.en: Containers and objects of various sizes
materials.zh: 不同大小的容器和物品

milestone.en: Voluntarily drops objects, although lacks control to place objects on a surface gently.
milestone.zh: 会主动放下物品，但还不能很好地控制轻轻放到表面上。

reminder.en: Avoid swallowable small objects and detachable parts when decreasing object size.
reminder.zh: 原文逐渐减小物品尺寸。不要使用可吞咽的小物品或可脱落的小零件。

reminderBasis: AAP：Choking Prevention

instructions.en: While feeding the baby, let her touch the food with her hands so that she can discover different textures. Then have her take some of the food that she has touched to her mouth so that she can associate taste and texture.
instructions.zh: 喂宝宝时，让宝宝用手摸食物，认识不同质地。再让宝宝把摸过的一些食物送进嘴里，把味道与触感联系起来。

materials.zh: 食物

milestone.en: High propensity to taste, suck, and take everything to the mouth as a way to better understand and explore the world.
milestone.zh: 常想把各种物品放入口中品尝或吮吸，以探索和理解周围世界。

instructions.en: Select a few objects with different textures and temperatures such as crinkled tinfoil, cotton balls, sticky tape, bottles with a cold and warm drink, or warm clothes after coming out of the dryer. Give them to the baby one at a time, encouraging her to discover the textures with her hands, while describing the characteristics of the item.
instructions.zh: 选一些质地和温度不同的物品，例如揉皱的铝箔、棉球、胶带、装有冷饮或温饮的瓶子、刚从烘干机拿出的温热衣物。逐个给宝宝，用手探索，同时描述物品特点。

materials.en: Objects with various textures and temperatures. i.e., tinfoil, cotton balls, sticky tape, a bottle with cold or warm drink, warm clothes after coming out of the dryer, etc.
materials.zh: 不同质地和温度的物品，例如铝箔、棉球、胶带、装冷饮或温饮的瓶子、烘干后温热的衣物等

milestone.en: Inferior Pincer Grasp: grasps objects between index finger and thumb but uses the entire surface of each finger, rather than only the fingertips, to hold the object.
milestone.zh: 初步钳式抓握：用食指和拇指夹物品，但用整个指面，而非仅用指尖。

reminder.en: Use cotton, tape and foil only for closely supervised touch; prevent mouthing and check temperatures first.
reminder.zh: 棉球、胶带、铝箔等只用于成人看护下触摸；避免入口，温热物品先由成人确认温度。

reminderBasis: 译者材料核对提示／Translator material review note

instructions.en: While dressing the baby, have her touch the different pieces of clothing. When she touches each, explain the various textures. For example, "This is your sock, it is very soft cotton" or "Feel the bottom of your shoe, it is bumpy leather."
instructions.zh: 给宝宝穿衣时，让宝宝摸各件衣物，并解释不同的触感。例如“这是你的袜子，是很柔软的棉”，或“摸摸鞋底，是凹凸不平的皮革”。

materials.zh: 穿衣时使用的宝宝衣物

duration.zh: 给宝宝穿衣或脱衣时进行

instructions.en: Show the baby diverse facial expressions and try to have him imitate them. For example, yawn while making loud noises, puff out your cheeks, or move your lips in different ways.
instructions.zh: 向宝宝展示不同的表情，鼓励模仿。例如，发出较大的声音并打哈欠、鼓起脸颊，或用不同方式活动嘴唇。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Has a mental model of the human face and becomes interested in the way it looks and its different forms of expression (e.g., happy face, sad face, etc.).
milestone.zh: 已形成对人脸的基本认知，开始关注脸的样子及不同表情，例如开心、难过。

instructions.en: Play music with different rhythms, clapping along to the beat. Encourage the baby to clap with you by exaggerating your clapping.
instructions.zh: 播放节奏不同的音乐，跟着节拍拍手。把拍手动作做得明显些，鼓励宝宝一起拍。

materials.zh: 音乐

milestone.en: Listens carefully to conversations and songs, understanding the difference in tones.
milestone.zh: 仔细听交谈和歌曲，能理解音调的不同。

goal.en: Identify the source of a sound

instructions.en: Find a few different toys that make different noises when moved, like a rattle or a bell, and have the baby play with the toys. Over time she will associate the specific noise with the toy.
instructions.zh: 准备几个动起来会发出不同声音的玩具，例如摇铃或铃铛，让宝宝玩。慢慢地，宝宝会把特定的声音与对应玩具联系起来。

materials.zh: 发声玩具

milestone.en: Attempts to imitate noises or sounds produced by objects (e.g., "boom!").
milestone.zh: 尝试模仿物品发出的声音，例如“砰！”。

goal.en: Teach the baby to get down from higher places

instructions.en: Often babies will crawl while on a bed without stopping at the edge or will also attempt to get down headfirst. Teach your baby to stop when getting close to the edge of the bed, turn around and get down with her feet first. To build this skill, put her on the bed with her feet on the edge of the bed. Then, holding her by her shoulders, slowly push her until her feet reach the floor. Repeat this exercise several times, gradually decreasing the level of help. It will take a few days, but she will eventually learn to turn around and get down the right way.
instructions.zh: 宝宝常会在床上向前爬，到了边缘也不停，或试图头朝下下床。教宝宝靠近床边时停下来、转身、双脚先下。把宝宝放在床上，双脚靠近床沿，扶住肩膀，慢慢推移，直到双脚落地。重复几次，逐渐减少帮助。原文说明，需要几天才能学会转身并以正确方向下来。

materials.zh: 床

milestone.en: Climbs onto and off of chairs and other furniture.
milestone.zh: 会爬上或爬下椅子及其他家具。

reminder.en: Pause before the source’s bed-edge movement; review fall risk and suitability with a pediatric professional.
reminder.zh: 先暂停照做。原文包含在床边推移宝宝的动作，存在跌落风险；先请儿科医生或儿童物理治疗师确认适用性。

reminderBasis: 译者针对原文的核对提示／Translator review note

goal.en: Improve the baby's sense of space

instructions.en: Show the baby that you are hiding a toy behind a large object. He may immediately reach for it. If not, help him get the toy by knocking down the object or moving around it to grab the toy.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝看到你把玩具藏在一个大物品后面。宝宝可能立即伸手去拿。若没有，帮助宝宝移开挡住的物品，或绕过去拿玩具。

materials.zh: 玩具、一个大物品

milestone.en: Reach Behind: seeks and reaches for an object that is behind self without needing to see it.
milestone.zh: 向后够物：不必看见，也会寻找并伸手够身后的物品。

goal.zh: 发展基本解决问题的能力

instructions.en: With the baby watching, place a toy that she wants inside a box or other container and cover it with a piece of fabric. If she doesn't reach inside to get the toy, encourage her to do so. She will eventually uncover the container and pull the toy out.
instructions.zh: 宝宝看着时，把想要的玩具放进箱子或其他容器，再盖上一块布。如果宝宝不伸手拿，给予鼓励。宝宝会逐渐学会揭开盖布，并取出玩具。

materials.zh: 玩具、箱子、一块布

instructions.en: Find a toy that the baby enjoys and practice giving and taking the toy. First give the toy to the baby, and then ask her to give it to you. If she doesn't give it to you, gently take it from her. You can use various toys to find one that she prefers. Eventually, she will tire of the game and want the toy just for herself. When she is frustrated, you can stop the exercise.
instructions.zh: 找一个宝宝喜欢的玩具，练习给与拿。先给宝宝，再请宝宝给你。若宝宝不愿给，轻轻取回。可以换不同玩具，找到最喜欢的。最后宝宝可能不想继续交换，只想自己拿着；宝宝感到烦躁时，就停止练习。

materials.zh: 玩具

milestone.en: Becomes protective of self and possessions; might fight over a toy.
milestone.zh: 开始保护自己和自己的物品，可能为玩具争抢。

goal.en: Increase the baby's level of response to verbal orders
goal.zh: 增强对口头指令的回应

instructions.en: Teach the baby simple games and movements in reaction to verbal requests. For example, "Give me five!" or "Wave bye-bye!" and help her do the actions with her hands. Once she starts understanding the movement and the meaning of the words, she will start doing it on her own when you ask her.
instructions.zh: 教宝宝根据简单口头要求做动作，例如“击掌！”或“挥手说再见！”，并帮助宝宝用手完成。理解动作与词语后，宝宝会在你提出要求时自己做。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Waves goodbye (between months 7 and 10).
milestone.zh: 会挥手再见，约在7–10个月之间出现。

goal.en: Perform the same action with several objects
goal.zh: 对不同物品执行同一动作

instructions.en: Pick a few different toys or objects and place them in a row on the floor or table. Ask the baby to give each toy to you, one at a time. Make sure to ask for the item by name "Please give Mommy the car." If he doesn't reach for the item immediately, guide his hand to the object and bring the item to you. Once he lets it go, thank him for giving it to you. Repeat the exercise frequently until he doesn't need your help to perform it.
instructions.zh: 选几个玩具或物品，在地板或桌上排成一列。逐个请宝宝递给你，用名称说清楚，例如“请把小汽车给妈妈”。若宝宝没有立即伸手，引导宝宝的手拿起并递过来。宝宝松手时表示感谢。经常练习，直到不需要帮助。

materials.zh: 不同的小玩具和物品

milestone.en: Understands individuality within a group (can pick one toy within a group, understands that they are separate toys vs. a single entity).
milestone.zh: 理解一组物品中每个物品是独立的，例如能从一组玩具里挑出一个。

goal.en: Develop ability to handle and grab objects of different sizes and shapes
goal.zh: 发展抓握和操作不同大小、形状物品的能力

instructions.en: Give the baby objects that are new to her and that are shapes with which she is not familiar. Examples include a Frisbee or lids from large pots and pans, which will force her to hold the edges; or a large balloon, which requires two hands to hold. Give the objects to the baby from different directions so that she has to move or rotate her hands in order to be able to grab them. Eventually do the same exercise while moving the objects.
instructions.zh: 给宝宝没接触过、形状不熟悉的物品，例如飞盘、大锅盖，促使宝宝抓住边缘；或需要双手抱住的大气球。从不同方向递给宝宝，让宝宝活动或转动手才能抓住。之后可在物品移动时做同样练习。

materials.en: Objects of different shapes and sizes
materials.zh: 不同形状和大小的物品

milestone.en: Able to grab and manipulate two objects simultaneously, one in each hand.
milestone.zh: 两只手能同时各抓握、操作一个物品。

reminder.en: Balloons and fragments are choking hazards; do not allow free mouthing or biting.
reminder.zh: 原文使用气球。气球和碎片有窒息风险，不能交给宝宝自由抓咬。

reminderBasis: AAP：Choking Prevention

goal.en: Develop ability to remove objects from a container
goal.zh: 发展从容器中取出物品的能力

instructions.en: Show the baby a small toy or object that sparks her curiosity. While she is looking at it, put it in a container and ask her to take it out. Start with a larger container, like a pitcher or a basket, and gradually decrease the size of the container until you are using small plastic cups.
instructions.zh: 给宝宝看一个能引起好奇的小玩具或物品。宝宝看着时，把它放进容器，请宝宝取出来。先用水壶、篮子等较大的容器，再逐渐缩小，直到使用小塑料杯。

materials.zh: 容器，例如水壶、篮子、塑料杯

milestone.en: Uses hands in different ways; for example, uses one as support and the other to manipulate an object.
milestone.zh: 双手能分工使用，例如一只手支撑，另一只手操作物品。

instructions.en: Put a single Cheerio or similar piece of food into a small cup or vial and encourage the baby to grab it with his index finger.
instructions.zh: 把一颗圈形谷物麦片或类似食物放进小杯或小管中，鼓励宝宝用食指取出。

materials.en: Small cup or vial, Cheerio or raisin
materials.zh: 小杯或小管、圈形谷物麦片或葡萄干

milestone.en: Inferior Pincer Grasp: grasps objects between index finger and thumb but uses the entire surface of each finger, rather than only the fingertips, to hold the object.
milestone.zh: 初步钳式抓握：用食指和拇指夹物品，但用整个指面，而非仅用指尖。

reminder.en: Review raisins and small food pieces for choking risk and suitable preparation; supervise eating while seated upright.
reminder.zh: 原文提到葡萄干与小颗粒食物。请先确认噎住风险与食物准备方式，进食时坐直并全程看护。

reminderBasis: CDC：Choking Hazards

instructions.en: If the baby uses a pacifier, give it to her with the external part facing her mouth so that she has to rotate it around to put it in her mouth. Once she can do it perfectly with the pacifier, you can increase the complexity by giving her a bottle with the nipple pointing away from her. The objective is to teach her to manipulate objects with her hands.
instructions.zh: 如果宝宝使用安抚奶嘴，把外侧朝向嘴巴递给宝宝，让宝宝自己转过来放进嘴里。掌握后，可把奶瓶的奶嘴朝外递给宝宝，增加难度。目的是学习用手转动和操作物品。

materials.zh: 安抚奶嘴

milestone.en: Examines objects from different sides and perspectives, improving understanding of 3-dimensional attributes of objects.
milestone.zh: 能从不同侧面和角度观察物品，更好地理解物品的立体特征。

goal.en: Increase the baby's interactions with people

instructions.en: Frequently play games that require the baby to interact with you directly, as opposed to toys. For example, sit him on your lap looking at you and gently touch your heads together after counting to 3. After a while he will start moving his head to touch yours in anticipation of the next round of the game.
instructions.zh: 经常玩需要宝宝与你直接互动的游戏。例如让宝宝坐在腿上面对你，数到3后轻轻碰一下彼此的头。玩一会儿后，宝宝会预期下一轮，主动把头靠向你。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

instructions.en: Expose your baby to different people. Get her used to interacting and playing with them as actively as possible.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝接触不同的人，逐渐习惯尽可能主动地与他们互动、玩耍。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Higher ability to focus; demonstrates curiosity about people.
milestone.zh: 注意力有所提高，对人表现出好奇。

goal.en: Learning to actively establish contact with other people
goal.zh: 学习主动与他人建立联系

instructions.en: Both parents sit in one corner of the room, away from the baby, and start an activity that might be fun for the baby, like stacking blocks or putting toys in a basket and emptying it. The objective is to get the baby's attention indirectly without calling her. At some point the baby will crawl to where her parents are and will try to join the activity.
instructions.zh: 两位家长坐在房间一角，离宝宝稍远，开始叠积木、把玩具放进篮子再倒出来等有趣活动。目标是不直接叫宝宝，而是间接吸引注意。宝宝可能会爬过来，尝试加入。

materials.zh: 玩具

milestone.en: Seeks social approval and interaction with social environment (e.g., performs actions to get applause).
milestone.zh: 寻求他人认可并与环境中的人互动，例如做动作来获得掌声。

goal.en: Transfer body weight from one foot to the other
goal.zh: 把身体重心从一只脚转到另一只脚

instructions.en: Hold the baby under her armpits in a standing position, with your body behind hers, with a ball in front of her. Simulate walking so that she accidentally kicks it while trying to take a step. Continue this activity, shifting her weight from side to side so that she kicks the ball with each leg. Eventually she will start kicking it voluntarily.
instructions.zh: 从宝宝身后，在腋下扶住宝宝站着，面前放一个球。帮助模拟走路，让宝宝迈步时偶然踢到球。继续左右转移重心，让两条腿都踢到。宝宝最终会主动踢球。

materials.zh: 球

instructions.en: The baby may already be feeding herself finger food; if not, encourage her by giving her a cracker or teething cookie. Help her take the food to her mouth by moving her hand for her. Once the cracker is in her mouth, encourage her to chew by imitating the act of chewing yourself.
instructions.zh: 如果宝宝还不会自己吃手指食物，可给一块饼干或磨牙饼干并鼓励尝试。移动宝宝的手，帮助把食物送到嘴边。饼干进入嘴里后，自己示范咀嚼，鼓励宝宝模仿。

materials.zh: 饼干或磨牙饼干

goal.en: Improve balance while in a sitting position

instructions.en: Place the child in a seated position and give her one or more large toys that require her to use both hands to grab them. You can use large balls, pillows, or stuffed animals. Place the toy in different positions, encouraging her to twist in order to reach the object.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝坐着，给一个或几个需要双手抓住的大玩具，例如大球、枕头或毛绒玩具。把玩具放在不同位置，鼓励宝宝转动身体去够。

materials.en: Large toys (i.e., large balls, pillows, or stuffed animals)
materials.zh: 大玩具，例如大球、枕头或毛绒玩具

milestone.en: Sits Alone: can remain in a steady seated position for several minutes without using arms as support.
milestone.zh: 独坐：能稳定坐几分钟，不用双臂支撑。

instructions.en: Show the baby drawings or pictures of animals, making the appropriate animal sound for each as you show it to her. Do the same when you are playing with her using stuffed animals or toys that resemble animals.
instructions.zh: 给宝宝看动物的图画或照片，每展示一种，就模仿对应的叫声。用动物毛绒玩具或动物造型玩具玩耍时，也这样做。

materials.zh: 动物图片

milestone.en: Might start combining more than one consonant-vowel syllable when babbling.
milestone.zh: 咿呀学语时，可能开始组合不止一种辅音加元音的音节。

instructions.en: With a mirror in front of both of you, ask the baby to point to you and then to him. Celebrate when he is right.
instructions.zh: 在你和宝宝面前放一面镜子，请宝宝指指你，再指指自己。指对时，给予鼓励。

materials.zh: 镜子

instructions.en: Put a bolster or a wide mailing tube on the floor and place the baby on top, lying on her chest. Gently roll her forward so that she has to put out her hands to prevent falling. As this becomes more comfortable, you can push faster or use a larger tube.
instructions.zh: 把圆柱垫或宽的邮寄纸筒放在地上，让宝宝胸部趴在上面。轻轻向前滚动，使宝宝伸出双手防止跌落。逐渐适应后，原文建议可推快一些或换更大的筒。

materials.zh: 圆柱垫或瑜伽垫

milestone.en: Crawling: able to crawl (between months 8-10); can do it forward or backward at the beginning.
milestone.zh: 爬行：约8–10个月能爬，最初可能向前或向后爬。

reminder.en: Pause before increasing speed to trigger a fall-prevention response; seek pediatric review of this movement.
reminder.zh: 先暂停照做。原文建议逐渐加快推移，让宝宝伸手防止跌落；先请儿科专业人员确认动作与适用性。

reminderBasis: 译者针对原文的核对提示／Translator review note

instructions.en: With a yoga ball or large beach ball, place the baby on top of the ball, facing down. Grab her tightly from the waist or hips and gently roll the ball forward so her head starts moving toward the floor. If she doesn't raise her arms to touch the floor, help her do it by moving her arms until her hands reach the floor. Keep practicing until she does it on her own.
instructions.zh: 用瑜伽球或大沙滩球，让宝宝趴在球上。牢牢扶住腰或髋部，轻轻向前滚球，让头部逐渐靠近地板。如果宝宝没有伸手，引导双臂，直到双手触地。持续练习，直到能自己伸手。

materials.en: Yoga ball or large beach ball
materials.zh: 瑜伽球或大沙滩球

milestone.en: Crawling: able to crawl (between months 8-10); can do it forward or backward at the beginning.
milestone.zh: 爬行：约8–10个月能爬，最初可能向前或向后爬。

reminder.en: Pause before moving the baby’s head toward the floor on a ball; seek pediatric review.
reminder.zh: 先暂停照做。原文让头部向地板移动并伸手触地；先请儿科医生或儿童物理治疗师确认动作。

reminderBasis: 译者针对原文的核对提示／Translator review note

instructions.en: Sit several inches in front of the baby when she is in crawling position. Encourage her to move forward to reach you or a toy you are holding with enthusiastic encouragement. You can say things like, "Come here to Mommy, you can do it!" or "I have your bear here."
instructions.zh: 宝宝摆出爬行姿势时，坐在面前约几英寸处，热情鼓励宝宝向前，来找你或拿你手里的玩具。例如“到妈妈这里来，你能做到！”或“你的小熊在我这里”。

materials.zh: 玩具

milestone.en: As baby transitions to proper crawling, may sway forward and backward in crawling position without actually moving.
milestone.zh: 开始学习正式爬行时，可能在爬行姿势中前后摇晃，却还没有向前移动。

title.zh: 物体恒存 IV：拉绳找玩具

goal.en: Stimulate the concept of object permanence

instructions.en: Give the baby a toy tied to a string. Put a portion of the toy under a pillow or blanket and show him that when he pulls the string the toy appears. Gradually increase the portion of the toy covered by the blanket until it is totally hidden. Celebrate each time the toy appears.
instructions.zh: 给宝宝一个系着绳子的玩具。把一部分藏在枕头或毯子下面，示范拉绳后玩具会出现。逐渐遮住更多部分，直到完全藏起来。每次玩具出现时，都给予鼓励。

materials.zh: 玩具、绳子

milestone.en: Short-Term Memory: remembers a series of actions completed in the immediate past, primarily in cases in which the baby was directly involved in the activity.
milestone.zh: 短期记忆：能记住刚完成的一系列动作，尤其是自己直接参与的活动。

reminder.en: Keep the string adult-controlled, away from the mouth and from entanglement; never leave it for independent play.
reminder.zh: 绳子仅由成人控制，避免缠绕或入口，不留给宝宝独自玩。

reminderBasis: AAP：Make Baby’s Room Safe；操作提示为译者说明

title.zh: 物体恒存 V：听声音找玩具

goal.en: Stimulate the concept of object permanence
