instructions.en: Create a barrier with pillows or boxes in front of the baby. Using a toy that makes sound, show the baby the toy and then move it behind the barrier, making sure that the toy continues to make noise. When the toy is hidden, say something like, "Uh oh! The car disappeared." Then bring the toy out from behind the barrier and say, "Here it is!" Hide the toy again and help the baby find it.
instructions.zh: 在宝宝面前用枕头或箱子摆一道遮挡。展示一个发声玩具，再移到遮挡后面，保持它发声。藏好时说“哎呀，小汽车不见了”，再拿出来说“在这里！”重新藏起，并帮助宝宝寻找。

materials.zh: 发声玩具

milestone.en: Short-Term Memory: remembers a series of actions completed in the immediate past, primarily in cases in which the baby was directly involved in the activity.
milestone.zh: 短期记忆：能记住刚完成的一系列动作，尤其是自己直接参与的活动。

title.zh: 物体恒存 VI：寻找掉落的物品

goal.en: Stimulate the concept of object permanence

instructions.en: Find a soft object, like an article of clothing, a sponge, or a cotton ball and let it fall to the floor so that the baby sees it drop. Make a game out of trying to find the item. Once she finds it, repeat the exercise until the baby looks to the floor without your encouragement to do so.
instructions.zh: 找一件柔软物品，例如衣服、海绵或棉球，让宝宝看到它掉到地上。把寻找物品变成游戏。找到后继续重复，直到宝宝不需要提示就会看向地板。

materials.zh: 海绵或棉球

milestone.en: Short-Term Memory: remembers a series of actions completed in the immediate past, primarily in cases in which the baby was directly involved in the activity.
milestone.zh: 短期记忆：能记住刚完成的一系列动作，尤其是自己直接参与的活动。

title.zh: 物体恒存 VII：从箱子里找玩具

goal.en: Stimulate the concept of object permanence

instructions.en: Using a cardboard box or other container that is not transparent, hide a toy that the baby has been playing with. Then tell the baby to find the toy. You may need to demonstrate where the toy is the first couple of times.
instructions.zh: 用纸箱或其他不透明容器，藏起宝宝刚玩过的玩具。请宝宝寻找。最初几次可能需要示范玩具在哪里。

materials.en: Cardboard box or other non-transparent container, toy
materials.zh: 纸箱或其他不透明容器、玩具

milestone.en: Short-Term Memory: remembers a series of actions completed in the immediate past, primarily in cases in which the baby was directly involved in the activity.
milestone.zh: 短期记忆：能记住刚完成的一系列动作，尤其是自己直接参与的活动。

title.zh: 物体恒存 VIII：解开布包找玩具

goal.en: Stimulate the concept of object permanence

instructions.en: Using a dishtowel or other piece of fabric, wrap a toy inside. Help the baby open the fabric to find the toy.
instructions.zh: 用擦碗布或其他布料包住一个玩具，帮助宝宝打开布，找到玩具。

materials.en: Dishtowel or other piece of fabric, toy
materials.zh: 擦碗布或其他布料、玩具

milestone.en: Able to grab and manipulate two objects simultaneously, one in each hand.
milestone.zh: 两只手能同时各抓握、操作一个物品。

instructions.en: Take the baby around the house, showing her how flipping a switch turns on a light or starts a fan. You can also show her how the doorbell works and how to open and close doors or windows.
instructions.zh: 带宝宝在家里看看，示范拨动开关会亮灯或启动风扇。也可展示门铃怎样工作，以及如何打开、关闭门窗。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Understanding Cause & Effect: anticipates events that consistently follow a "signal" (e.g., if baby hears the doorbell, will anticipate someone's arrival).
milestone.zh: 理解因果：能预期固定信号之后的事情，例如听到门铃，就预期有人到来。

title.en: One Hand to the Other - II

instructions.en: Get two small balls. Give one to the baby and keep the other for yourself. Start moving your ball from one hand to the other, encouraging her to imitate you. Describe what you are doing as you do it: "In one hand, in my other hand." Initially, you will need to assist her, but eventually she will be able to do it alone.
instructions.zh: 准备两个小球，给宝宝一个，自己留一个。把球从一只手换到另一只手，鼓励模仿。边做边说“在这只手里，现在到另一只手”。起初需要帮助，最终宝宝能独立完成。

materials.zh: 两个小球

title.en: One Hand to the Other - III

goal.en: Improve hand-eye coordination and ability to manipulate objects
goal.zh: 改善手眼协调及操作物品的能力

instructions.en: Give her one small object and try to have her move it from one hand to the other. Then give her two more small objects, one at a time. She is likely to drop one of the first two objects in order to grab the third one. Repeat it several times trying to have her figure out a way to hold the three objects at the same time.
instructions.zh: 给宝宝一个小物品，鼓励从一只手换到另一只。再逐个给两个小物品。宝宝可能为了拿第三个而放下前两个中的一个。重复几次，鼓励宝宝想办法同时拿住三个。

materials.zh: 三个小玩具或小物品

milestone.en: Able to carry two small objects in one hand.
milestone.zh: 能用一只手拿两个小物品。

reminder.en: Use objects too large to swallow with no detachable small parts.
reminder.zh: 原文使用小物品。只使用不会被吞咽、没有可脱落小零件的材料。

reminderBasis: AAP：Choking Prevention

instructions.en: Using finger paints or shaving cream on paper, a large window, or shower door, help the baby move her finger through the substance to make lines or circles.
instructions.zh: 把手指画颜料或剃须泡沫放在纸、大窗户或淋浴门上，帮助宝宝用手指在上面划出线条或圆圈。

materials.en: Finger paint or shaving cream, appropriate surface for the exercise
materials.zh: 手指画颜料或剃须泡沫、适合练习的表面

reminder.en: The source includes shaving cream. Review suitability and product safety before use; prevent mouthing.
reminder.zh: 原文包含剃须泡沫。不要直接视为婴儿适用材料，先确认产品与材料安全；避免入口。

reminderBasis: 译者材料核对提示／Translator material review note

goal.en: Stimulate the concept of object permanence

instructions.en: After demonstrating how to play peekaboo with your baby, place his hands or a towel on his face and encourage him to uncover it while shouting "Peekaboo." Applaud and laugh each time he does it to demonstrate your enthusiasm.
instructions.zh: 先示范躲猫猫，再用宝宝的双手或毛巾遮住脸，鼓励宝宝揭开，同时喊“躲猫猫！”或“看见啦！”。每次成功，你都鼓掌、笑着表示开心。

materials.en: Towel or small piece of fabric
materials.zh: 毛巾或一小块布

milestone.en: Object Permanence: is able to recover an object that has been hidden as she observes.
milestone.zh: 物体恒存：能找回在自己看着时被藏起来的物品。

instructions.en: Organize play dates with other children of a similar age or let the baby interact with peers at the playground so that the baby continues to get familiar with more and more people.
instructions.zh: 安排与年龄相近的宝宝一起玩，或在游乐场与同龄伙伴互动，让宝宝逐渐熟悉更多的人。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Reacts to seeing a picture of another baby with babbling or movement; associates the image with self.
milestone.zh: 看到其他宝宝的照片会发声或活动，把图像与自己联系起来。

instructions.en: Give the baby a non-toxic play dough or edible dough and let her experiment with it while supervising. Show her how to poke and pinch it with her first two fingers and thumb.
instructions.zh: 给宝宝无毒玩具面团或可食用面团，在看护下自由探索。示范用食指、中指和拇指戳、捏面团。

materials.zh: 玩具面团

milestone.en: Radial Digital Grasp: grasps objects using index finger, middle finger and thumb.
milestone.zh: 桡侧手指抓握：用食指、中指和拇指抓物品。

instructions.en: Give the baby a ball of non-toxic play dough or pastry dough you make. Teach her to manipulate the ball with her hands, pulling it and stretching it until it breaks. Introduce the idea of different textures to her. With the plain ball of dough, you can say, "This is smooth." Have her put a few popsicle sticks into the dough and have her touch it, saying, "This is bumpy" or "This is hard."
instructions.zh: 给宝宝一团无毒玩具面团或自制糕点面团，教宝宝用手拉、伸，直到扯断。介绍触感：普通面团可以说“这是光滑的”。再插入几根冰棒棍，让宝宝摸，解释“这是凹凸不平的”或“这是硬的”。

materials.en: Non-toxic play dough (or silly putty), small non-sharp sticks
materials.zh: 无毒玩具面团或弹性胶泥、小而不尖锐的棍子

milestone.en: Inferior Pincer Grasp: grasps objects between index finger and thumb but uses the entire surface of each finger, rather than only the fingertips, to hold the object.
milestone.zh: 初步钳式抓握：用食指和拇指夹物品，但用整个指面，而非仅用指尖。

instructions.en: Demonstrate banging a block or spoon on a tabletop or high chair tray and encourage the baby to imitate your actions.
instructions.zh: 示范用积木或勺子敲桌面或餐椅托盘，鼓励宝宝模仿。

materials.zh: 桌子、积木或勺子

instructions.en: Give the baby a drum with drumsticks or a plastic bowl with wooden spoons. Teach her how to hit the drum with one stick and her hand, then both sticks. Initially she is likely to hit both sticks or spoons simultaneously, but will begin to alternate as she approaches one year of age.
instructions.zh: 给宝宝鼓和鼓槌，或塑料碗和木勺。先教宝宝用一根鼓槌配合一只手敲，再用两根鼓槌。起初可能两根同时敲，到接近一岁时会开始交替敲。

materials.zh: 鼓、鼓槌

goal.en: Improve ability to manipulate an object

instructions.en: Teach the child how to play notes on a toy piano using a single finger. Then try using two or more fingers. If you don't have a toy piano, you can do the same on a smartphone or tablet app.
instructions.zh: 教宝宝用一根手指在玩具钢琴上按出音符，再试两根或更多手指。如果没有玩具钢琴，也可以使用手机或平板上的钢琴应用。

materials.en: Toy piano or smartphone piano app
materials.zh: 玩具钢琴或手机钢琴应用

goal.en: Reinforce relationship between parents and baby

instructions.en: An effective way to increase the bond between parent and child is to play. Interesting games create challenges and a sense of accomplishment for the baby. Throughout the day allocate time to play new games. Hiding objects, playing peekaboo, and making sounds from unexpected places are all appropriate for this age.
instructions.zh: 玩耍能有效增进亲子联系。有趣的游戏为宝宝带来挑战和成就感。一天中安排时间尝试新游戏。藏物品、躲猫猫、从意想不到的位置发出声音，都适合这个年龄阶段。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Higher ability to focus; demonstrates curiosity about people.
milestone.zh: 注意力有所提高，对人表现出好奇。

goal.zh: 把词语与动作联系起来

instructions.en: Give the baby a doll or stuffed animal and take another one yourself. Perform various actions on the doll while you describe them to the baby. For example, "Let's feed the baby" or "Let's put the baby to sleep" or "Let's snuggle with the dog."
instructions.zh: 给宝宝一个娃娃或毛绒玩具，自己也拿一个。边对娃娃做动作，边描述，例如“我们喂宝宝吃饭”“我们哄宝宝睡觉”或“我们抱抱小狗”。

materials.zh: 两个娃娃或毛绒玩具

milestone.en: Can imitate inflections, the rhythm of a conversation, and facial expressions more accurately than the words in the conversation.
milestone.zh: 模仿语调、交谈节奏和表情，比模仿交谈中的词语更准确。

goal.en: Learn to point with index finger

instructions.en: Encourage the baby to point at different objects in picture books. You can move her hand and show her how to point, describing the object as you do it. Over time she will learn to point on her own.
instructions.zh: 鼓励宝宝指图画书中的不同物品。可帮助移动宝宝的手，示范如何指，同时说出物品。宝宝会逐渐学会自己指。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

goal.en: Improve ability to use fingers independently
goal.zh: 改善手指独立活动能力

instructions.en: Using play dough or other child-safe clay, show the baby how to poke holes into the surface with her fingers. First take her hand and demonstrate it for her, then let her try on her own.
instructions.zh: 用玩具面团或其他适合儿童的黏土，示范用手指在表面戳洞。先握住宝宝的手示范，再让宝宝自己试。

materials.zh: 玩具面团、适合儿童的黏土

milestone.en: Uses hands in different ways; for example, uses one as support and the other to manipulate an object.
milestone.zh: 双手能分工使用，例如一只手支撑，另一只手操作物品。

instructions.en: Introduce activities that require the child to remove and manipulate objects, which will help him increase hand strength. For example, teach him to place plastic rings on a stick or rod and then encourage him to remove them, show him how to remove the pegs from a pegboard or ask him to take the tops off of boxes or other containers.
instructions.zh: 安排需要取下和操作物品的活动。例如教宝宝把塑料环套在棍或杆上，再鼓励取下；示范从插孔板上拔出插钉，或请宝宝取下箱子、其他容器的盖子。

materials.zh: 插孔板、不同类型的容器

milestone.en: Uses hands in different ways; for example, uses one as support and the other to manipulate an object.
milestone.zh: 双手能分工使用，例如一只手支撑，另一只手操作物品。

goal.en: Improve manual dexterity and provide exposure to different textures
goal.zh: 改善手部灵活性并接触不同质地

instructions.en: In each of three different containers, like a pot, a pitcher and a basket, place an object with a different texture. For example, a sponge in one, nail file in another, and stone in the third. Then put each container in a different position, perhaps one standing vertically, the other one facing one side and the third facing another side. Encourage the baby to get the object out of each container.
instructions.zh: 准备三个不同容器，例如锅、水壶、篮子，各放一种质地不同的物品，例如海绵、指甲锉、石头。把容器摆成不同方向：一个竖放，一个朝一侧，另一个朝另一侧。鼓励宝宝从每个容器取出物品。

materials.zh: 三个容器、三种不同质地的物品

reminder.en: Replace the source’s stones and nail file with suitable materials; avoid swallowable or sharp objects.
reminder.zh: 原文使用石头和指甲锉。不要把可吞咽或尖锐物品交给宝宝；先更换为适用材料。

reminderBasis: AAP：Choking Prevention；材料替换为译者提示

goal.en: Understand using a tool in different situations to produce similar results
goal.zh: 理解在不同情境中用工具得到相似结果

instructions.en: Tie a toy to a string and place it beyond the baby's reach. Demonstrate how to bring the toy closer by pulling the string. Once she masters this, you can change the type of string or the toy or use a push-pull toy on a stick and repeat the exercise. Do the exercise in different places, helping her to understand that the concept applies to any toy, string, or place.
instructions.zh: 把玩具系在绳子上，放在宝宝够不到的位置。示范拉绳把玩具拉近。掌握后，更换绳子或玩具，或改用带杆的推拉玩具。换不同地点重复，帮助理解：各种玩具、绳子和地点都可以这样使用。

materials.zh: 绳子、玩具、带杆的推拉玩具

milestone.en: Short-Term Memory: remembers a series of actions completed in the immediate past, primarily in cases in which the baby was directly involved in the activity.
milestone.zh: 短期记忆：能记住刚完成的一系列动作，尤其是自己直接参与的活动。

reminder.en: Keep strings adult-controlled and prevent mouthing or entanglement; never leave them for independent play.
reminder.zh: 绳子仅由成人控制，避免缠绕或入口，不留给宝宝独自玩。

reminderBasis: AAP：Make Baby’s Room Safe；操作提示为译者说明

title.en: Reaching for Toy in Front - IV

instructions.en: Put one of the baby's favorite toys on a small blanket and demonstrate that pulling the blanket brings the toy closer. Encourage any effort he makes to do it.
instructions.zh: 把宝宝喜欢的玩具放在小毯子上，示范拉毯子能让玩具靠近。宝宝尝试时，都给予鼓励。

materials.zh: 毯子、玩具

instructions.en: Read short stories to the baby, using the baby's name frequently to help maintain his attention while you read. While the complexity of the stories will increase, you should continue to perform this activity frequently for as long as you can. Reading has multiple significant benefits for your child.
instructions.zh: 给宝宝读短故事，常提到宝宝的名字，帮助保持注意。随着成长，故事会逐渐复杂，但应尽可能长期、经常坚持阅读。原文说明，阅读对孩子有多方面的重要益处。

materials.zh: 书

milestone.en: Might start combining more than one consonant-vowel syllable when babbling.
milestone.zh: 咿呀学语时，可能开始组合不止一种辅音加元音的音节。

title.zh: 恢复坐姿 II：向前撑手

instructions.en: On a soft surface, place the baby in a seated position while you are sitting behind her. Place your hands on her upper arms and gently push her forward, while guiding her arms toward the floor. The goal is for her to stop herself with her hands while she is leaning forward. As the reaction becomes automatic, you can move the baby more quickly, pushing her so that she develops the reaction.
instructions.zh: 在柔软表面让宝宝坐着，自己坐在身后。双手放在上臂，轻轻向前推移，并引导双臂向地面，让宝宝前倾时用双手支撑。动作逐渐自动化后，原文建议可以加快推移，培养反应。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Strong Sitting: displays good balance while seated without using arms as support; bends forward and backward to reach for a nearby object.
milestone.zh: 稳坐：坐着时不用手臂支撑也能保持平衡，并能前后弯身去够附近物品。

reminder.en: Pause before progressively faster pushing to trigger a hand-support response; seek pediatric review.
reminder.zh: 先暂停照做。原文建议逐渐加快推移宝宝以触发撑手反应；先请儿科专业人员确认动作。

reminderBasis: 译者针对原文的核对提示／Translator review note

title.zh: 恢复坐姿 III：侧向撑手

instructions.en: On a soft surface, place the baby in a seated position while you are sitting behind her. Place your hands on her upper arms and gently push her to one side, while guiding her hand toward the floor. The goal is for her to stop herself with the hand while she is leaning to the side. As the reaction becomes automatic, you can move the baby more quickly, pushing her so that she develops the reaction.
instructions.zh: 在柔软表面让宝宝坐着，自己坐在身后。双手放在上臂，轻轻向一侧推移，并引导手向地面，让宝宝侧倾时用手支撑。动作逐渐自动化后，原文建议可以加快推移，培养反应。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Strong Sitting: displays good balance while seated without using arms as support; bends forward and backward to reach for a nearby object.
milestone.zh: 稳坐：坐着时不用手臂支撑也能保持平衡，并能前后弯身去够附近物品。

reminder.en: Pause before faster sideways pushing to trigger a hand-support response; seek pediatric review.
reminder.zh: 先暂停照做。原文建议逐渐加快侧向推移以触发撑手反应；先请儿科专业人员确认动作。

reminderBasis: 译者针对原文的核对提示／Translator review note

title.zh: 恢复坐姿 IV：伸手后坐回

instructions.en: Put the baby in a seated position and find a toy that he is interested in. Hold it just out of reach to the side or above his head. Once he reaches for the toy, encourage him to return to seated position. Repeat the activity.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝坐着，找一个感兴趣的玩具，放在侧面或头上方、刚好够不到的位置。宝宝伸手拿时，鼓励回到坐姿，再重复。

materials.zh: 玩具

milestone.en: Sits Alone: can remain in a steady seated position for several minutes without using arms as support.
milestone.zh: 独坐：能稳定坐几分钟，不用双臂支撑。

title.zh: 恢复坐姿 V：向后撑手

instructions.en: Put the baby in a seated position and sit immediately behind him. Grab him by the shoulders and gently pull him backwards. The goal is to have him automatically use his arms to break his fall. Initially, you will likely have to move his arms for him so that he is introduced to the movement.
instructions.zh: 宝宝坐着，你紧靠在身后。扶住肩膀，轻轻向后带动，让宝宝自动用双臂支撑，防止倒下。起初可能需要帮助移动双臂，熟悉这个动作。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Sits Alone: can remain in a steady seated position for several minutes without using arms as support.
milestone.zh: 独坐：能稳定坐几分钟，不用双臂支撑。

title.zh: 恢复坐姿 VI：在腿上保持平衡

instructions.en: While you are sitting on a chair, have the baby straddle one of your legs. Holding his shoulders or arms, move him from side to side, encouraging him to return to a seated position.
instructions.zh: 你坐在椅子上，让宝宝跨坐在一条腿上。扶住肩膀或双臂，左右移动，鼓励宝宝恢复坐直。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Sits Alone: can remain in a steady seated position for several minutes without using arms as support.
milestone.zh: 独坐：能稳定坐几分钟，不用双臂支撑。

goal.en: Stimulate the baby's sense of smell

instructions.en: When cooking or preparing meals, introduce different scents and flavors to the baby. As you let him smell and taste, say the name of each food.
instructions.zh: 做饭或准备餐点时，让宝宝接触不同的气味和味道。每次闻或尝时，都说出食物名称。

materials.zh: 用餐时准备的食物

milestone.en: Begins to develop strong preferences for different food tastes.
milestone.zh: 开始对不同食物的味道形成明显偏好。

goal.en: Increase the baby's interactions with people

instructions.en: Around this age, many babies will start to experience separation anxiety. You should take your baby with you when you are engaged in any kind of social activity, like visiting friends, eating out, or shopping. Periodically have other people hold the baby for brief periods to increase her comfort with strangers.
instructions.zh: 这个年龄的很多宝宝开始出现分离焦虑。拜访朋友、外出吃饭或购物等社交活动时，可以带上宝宝。偶尔让别人短时间抱抱宝宝，增加对陌生人的熟悉与适应。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Separation Anxiety: triggered by new understanding that baby and mother are separate entities; realizes mother might leave the baby periodically.
milestone.zh: 分离焦虑：逐渐理解自己与妈妈是不同的人，并意识到妈妈可能暂时离开。

instructions.en: Put the baby's hands on a radio, speaker, or another musical object that vibrates. Turn it on and off so that he can perceive the vibrations caused by music.
instructions.zh: 把宝宝的手放在收音机、音箱或其他播放音乐时会振动的物品上。打开、关闭，让宝宝感受音乐带来的振动。

materials.zh: 音箱或收音机

instructions.en: With your baby lying on her back, hold her by the arms and slowly help her to a seated position. Then gradually continue, helping her to stand up.
instructions.zh: 宝宝仰卧时，握住双臂，慢慢帮助坐起；再继续逐步帮助站起来。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Can maintain a standing position by using furniture as support; still can't stand up without help.
milestone.zh: 扶着家具能保持站姿，但还不能独立站起。

reminder.en: Pause before the source’s arm-held pull to sitting and standing. Avoid lifting by hands or wrists; seek pediatric review.
reminder.zh: 先暂停照做。原文握住双臂拉坐、拉站；不要通过手或手腕提拉宝宝，先请儿科专业人员确认。

reminderBasis: AAP：Nursemaid’s Elbow；动作核对为译者提示

title.zh: 站起来 II：扶家具起身

instructions.en: Position the baby close to the railing of her crib or next to a low piece of furniture. From above offer him a toy that she likes, just out of her reach. Encourage her to stand up to get the toy, pointing out the railing or the furniture as something that can help her stand. Assist her as necessary.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝靠近婴儿床栏杆或较低的家具。从上方拿出喜欢的玩具，放在刚好够不到的位置。鼓励站起去拿，并指出栏杆或家具可以提供支撑。根据需要帮助。

materials.zh: 玩具、婴儿床或家具

milestone.en: Can maintain a standing position by using furniture as support; still can't stand up without help.
milestone.zh: 扶着家具能保持站姿，但还不能独立站起。

title.zh: 站起来 III：从矮凳起身

instructions.en: Seat the child on a small chair or stepstool. Hold her hands and encourage her to stand up, gently pulling her up very slowly, shifting her weight over her feet until she is standing.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝坐在小椅子或矮凳上。握住双手，鼓励站起来；非常缓慢地轻拉，帮助重心移到双脚，直到站稳。

materials.zh: 小椅子或矮凳

milestone.en: Pull to Stand: starts using furniture to try to stand, still needs help.
milestone.zh: 扶物起立：开始借助家具尝试站起，仍需要帮助。

reminder.en: Pause before pulling the baby up by the hands. Avoid lifting by hands or wrists; seek pediatric review.
reminder.zh: 先暂停照做。原文通过拉双手帮助站起；不要通过手或手腕提拉宝宝，先请儿科专业人员确认。

reminderBasis: AAP：Nursemaid’s Elbow

title.zh: 站起来 IV：扶箱子起身

instructions.en: Place a sturdy box or stool about 6 or 7 inches high between you and your child. Hold a toy or other interesting object just out of the baby's reach when seated, so that the baby needs to stand up to grab it. The objective is to have the baby use the stool as support to first kneel and then stand to reach the toy. You can also leave the toy on the box or stool provided the baby could reach it only after standing up.
instructions.zh: 在你和宝宝之间放一个高约15–18厘米的结实箱子或矮凳。把玩具放在坐着刚好够不到的位置，让宝宝需要站起来才能拿。目标是借箱子支撑，先跪起，再站起。也可把玩具放在箱子上，但应只有站起来才能拿到。

materials.en: Small box or stool (about 7 in tall)
materials.zh: 小箱子或矮凳，约18厘米高

milestone.en: Pull to Stand: starts using furniture to try to stand, still needs help.
milestone.zh: 扶物起立：开始借助家具尝试站起，仍需要帮助。

instructions.en: While you are lying down with your legs extended, place the baby so that he is lying on top of you with his legs on your stomach and his back against your thighs. Hold his hands and gently pull to help him stand up on your stomach. If necessary, you can bend your legs to make it easier. Do it several times.
instructions.zh: 你躺着伸直双腿，让宝宝躺在你身上，双腿放在腹部，背靠你的大腿。握住宝宝双手，轻轻拉起，帮助站在你的腹部上。需要时弯曲你的腿，让动作容易些。重复几次。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Can maintain a standing position by using furniture as support; still can't stand up without help.
milestone.zh: 扶着家具能保持站姿，但还不能独立站起。

reminder.en: Pause before pulling the baby by the hands to stand on an adult. Avoid lifting by hands or wrists; seek pediatric review.
reminder.zh: 先暂停照做。原文拉双手让宝宝站在成人腹部上；不要通过手或手腕提拉宝宝，先请儿科专业人员确认。

reminderBasis: AAP：Nursemaid’s Elbow

instructions.en: Show the baby a watch and explain: "This is a watch; it makes a 'tick tock' sound," although it's likely your watch makes no sound. Then ask: "Where is the watch?" If she turns to the watch, repeat the exercise asking her: "Where is the 'tick tock'?" Repeat the exercise until she is able to identify the object both by its name and sound. It can also be done with animals or other objects.
instructions.zh: 给宝宝看手表，解释“这是手表，会发出滴答声”，即使手表实际不发声。问“手表在哪里？”宝宝转头看时，再问“滴答滴答在哪里？”。重复，直到宝宝能根据名称和声音辨认物品。也可用动物或其他物品练习。

materials.zh: 手表或动物

milestone.en: Hearing fuels curiosity; pays close attention to subtle sounds like the ticking of a clock.
milestone.zh: 声音引起好奇，会仔细听细微的声音，例如钟表滴答声。

goal.en: Transfer body weight from one foot to the other
goal.zh: 把身体重心从一只脚转到另一只脚

instructions.en: Stand the baby in front of a bed or couch and have her face the furniture, using one or both hands for support. Put a toy on the floor a few inches from her right foot. Encourage her to get the toy, which will require her to transfer her weight to her right leg. Let her play with the toy for a few minutes. Then place that toy or another toy near her left foot, requiring her to do the same exercise on the other side.
instructions.zh: 让宝宝面对床或沙发站着，用一只或两只手扶住家具。把玩具放在右脚旁几英寸处，鼓励去拿，让重心移到右腿。玩几分钟后，再把同一件或另一件玩具放在左脚旁，练习另一侧。

materials.zh: 床

milestone.en: Attempts to Cruise: while standing supported by furniture, tries to place one foot in front of the other to move.
milestone.zh: 尝试扶走：扶着家具站立时，试着把一只脚放到另一只脚前方来移动。

instructions.en: Show the baby how to turn a radio off and on. Do it a few times, so that she associates cause and effect. Encourage her to do it. Repeat the exercise with other devices and lights in your house.
instructions.zh: 示范打开、关闭收音机，重复几次，让宝宝把原因与结果联系起来。鼓励宝宝试着操作，再用家中其他设备和灯重复练习。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Short-Term Memory: remembers a series of actions completed in the immediate past, primarily in cases in which the baby was directly involved in the activity.
milestone.zh: 短期记忆：能记住刚完成的一系列动作，尤其是自己直接参与的活动。

goal.en: Learn to use/handle an object in different ways
goal.zh: 学习用不同方式使用和操作物品

instructions.en: Give the baby a piece of paper and show her how she can crumple, smooth, or tear it. You can also use play dough for this purpose, showing her how to make a ball or a long snake that she can turn into a circle. You can also put a few small objects inside a small plastic container and show her that by moving it, she can make the objects inside shift from side to side. Shake the container quickly to show her that she can have the objects make noise like a rattle.
instructions.zh: 给宝宝一张纸，示范揉、抚平或撕。也可用面团，示范揉成球、搓成长条，再弯成圈。还可在小塑料容器内放几个小物品，示范移动容器会让物品左右移动；快速摇动时，会像摇铃一样发出声音。

materials.en: Various materials (i.e., paper, play dough, etc.)
materials.zh: 不同材料，例如纸、玩具面团等

milestone.en: Able to hold several ideas in mind at the same time (e.g., can communicate with mom while playing).
milestone.zh: 能同时记住几个想法，例如一边玩一边与妈妈交流。

reminder.en: Secure the container so its contents and small parts cannot enter the baby’s mouth.
reminder.zh: 容器要牢固封闭，不能让内部小物品或可脱落零件进入宝宝口中。

reminderBasis: AAP：Choking Prevention

instructions.en: Using paper, show the baby how to crumple it, tear it, draw on it and turn the pages of a book.
instructions.zh: 用纸示范揉、撕、画画，以及翻书页。

materials.zh: 纸和书

milestone.en: Uses hands in different ways; for example, uses one as support and the other to manipulate an object.
milestone.zh: 双手能分工使用，例如一只手支撑，另一只手操作物品。

goal.en: Perform actions by using verbal instructions

instructions.en: Whenever you are doing BabySparks exercises or anything else that encourages movement or stimulation, consistently provide verbal descriptions of what you are doing. This is one of the best ways to develop the baby's passive language and to help show that specific words describe a particular action, which she can then do. For example, saying "Up" or "Down" while you help her to get to a sitting position, will eventually lead to her being able to do the same exercise just by following your verbal direction when she has the motor skills.
instructions.zh: 做BabySparks活动或其他动作、感官游戏时，持续用语言描述正在做的事。这能培养宝宝理解语言，并认识词语与具体动作的联系。例如帮助坐起时说“上”“下”；具备相应动作能力后，宝宝会逐渐能只听指令就完成。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Able to hold several ideas in mind at the same time (e.g., can communicate with mom while playing).
milestone.zh: 能同时记住几个想法，例如一边玩一边与妈妈交流。

instructions.en: With the baby facing down, raise her legs to try to get her to push up with her hands like playing wheelbarrow. Initially, she might need assistance moving her arms, which will require an additional adult to help. Eventually she will be able to move her arms on her own.
instructions.zh: 宝宝趴着时，抬起双腿，鼓励用双手撑起身体，像推小车一样。起初可能需要另一位成人帮助移动双臂，最终宝宝会自己移动。

materials.zh: 不需要材料，只需照护者

milestone.en: Attempts to get up on hands and knees to get into a crawling position.
milestone.zh: 尝试用双手和膝盖撑起身体，进入爬行姿势。

goal.en: Developing the concept of yes and no
goal.zh: 理解可以与不可以的概念

instructions.en: Sit at the table with the baby and place two objects in front of you, one an appropriate toy for the baby and the other an inappropriate object, like matches or scissors. After observing both objects the baby will try to reach for one. If she goes for the appropriate one, smile and say, "Yes, you may play with this toy." If she goes for the other one, shake your head and say in a serious tone, "No, matches are not for babies."
instructions.zh: 和宝宝坐在桌前，放两个物品：一个适合宝宝的玩具，另一个不适合的物品，例如火柴或剪刀。宝宝伸手拿玩具时，微笑说“可以，你可以玩这个”。若伸手拿另一个，就摇头，用认真语气说“不可以，火柴不是给宝宝玩的”。

materials.en: A toy and matches or scissors
materials.zh: 一个玩具，以及火柴或剪刀

milestone.en: Says " No" while shaking head side to side.
milestone.zh: 边左右摇头边说“不”。

reminder.en: Keep the source’s matches or scissors out of the baby’s reach and adult-controlled; do not offer them directly.
reminder.zh: 原文使用火柴或剪刀演示。不要放在宝宝可拿到的位置；只由成人保管，避免直接照做该步骤。

reminderBasis: 译者针对原文的核对提示／Translator review note
